	cost: z.number().int().optional(),
	costOptionItemId: z.string().nullable(),
	currency: z.enum(CurrencyCode),
	productId: z.string().optional(),
	quantity: z.number().int(),
	quantityModifier: z.enum(QuantityModifier),
	shipping: z.number().int().optional(),
	variants: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
})
export type ApplicableProductCostItem = Z.infer<typeof ApplicableProductCostItemSchema>

/** One effective cost rule (a single option's slice), shaped for the solver. */
export const ApplicableProductCostSchema = z.object({
	cost: z.number().int().optional(),
	costId: z.string(),
	costOptionId: z.string(),
	country: z.string().optional(),
	endDate: z.date().nullable(),
	data: z.array(ApplicableProductCostItemSchema),
	productId: z.string().optional(),
	shipping: z.number().int().optional(),
	startDate: z.date(),
	type: z.enum(ProductCostType),
	variants: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
})
export type ApplicableProductCost = Z.infer<typeof ApplicableProductCostSchema>

		costQuery.nextCosts = [
			{
				costId: 'cost-1',

		const byLine = override!.fields.productCostByLine
		expect(byLine).toHaveLength(1)
		expect(byLine![0]!.lineId).toBe('line-1')

		expect(byLine![0]!.cost.amountCents).toBe(1000)
		expect(byLine![0]!.cost.currency).toBe(CurrencyCode.USD)
	})

	it('OrderUpdated with no matching cost → no per-line cost entries', async () => {

		expect(override?.fields.productCostByLine ?? []).toHaveLength(0)
	})

All tenancy middleware tests pass (10/10). The move and reshape are complete.

## Summary

**Moved + reshaped `RequireStoreMember` from auth → tenancy.**

Files:
- **Created** `/Users/work/Desktop/Projetos/pessoal/template-fullstack/packages/api/typescript/src/tenancy/middlewares/RequireStoreMember.ts` — reshaped middleware.
- **Created** `/Users/work/Desktop/Projetos/pessoal/template-fullstack/packages/api/typescript/src/tenancy/middlewares/RequireStoreMember.test.ts` — moved + updated test.
- **Edited** `src/tenancy/middlewares/index.ts` — barrel now exports both `RequireStoreMember` and `RequireStoreRole`.
- **Deleted** `src/auth/middlewares/RequireStoreMember.ts` and `src/auth/middlewares/RequireStoreMember.test.ts`.
- **Edited** `src/auth/middlewares/index.ts` — removed the `RequireStoreMember` export (now only `AuthAccountMiddleware`).

**Reshape (behavior change):**
- Validates `ctx.user.id` is a member of `ctx.session.storeId` via `StoreMembershipRepository.findByStoreAndUser`; throws `STORE_MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND` (→404) on parse failure, missing `storeId`, or miss.
- No longer stamps `ctx.membership.storeId` (controllers now read `ctx.session.storeId` directly).
- Now stamps `ctx.membership = { id, userId, role, storeIds }` — `id`/`role`/`userId` from the active membership; `storeIds = (await findByUserId(userId)).map(m => m.storeId)`. Kept dependency-light (only `StoreMembershipRepository` + `SessionSchema`).

**Dependency direction:** the move removes auth's only dependency on `@tenancy/*` (those two files); tenancy importing `@auth/schemas` SessionSchema is consistent with tenancy already importing `@auth/middlewares/AuthAccountMiddleware` elsewhere.

**Verification:**
- `bun x tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit` on `src/tenancy/` + `src/auth/`: **no NEW errors from the move**. The only remaining tenancy/auth errors are the 7 expected per-context controller imports of the old `@auth/middlewares/RequireStoreMember` path (`ChangeMemberRole`, `DisableStore`, `EnableStore`, `InviteMember`, `RemoveMember`, `UpdateStorePreferences`, `UpdateStoreSettings`) — these re-point to `@tenancy/middlewares/RequireStoreMember` in phase C and are out of scope.
- No DI-registry references, and no barrel (`@auth/middlewares`) consumers of `RequireStoreMember` existed (all barrel imports were `AuthAccountMiddleware` only) — nothing broke outside the per-context controllers.
- `bun test src/tenancy/middlewares/`: **10 pass / 0 fail** (5 RequireStoreMember + 5 RequireStoreRole).

Note: SessionSchema.ts and RequireStoreRole.ts contain doc-comment mentions of `RequireStoreMember` only (no imports) — left as-is, still accurate.

export const SendNotificationControllerInputSchema = z.object({
	ctx: z.object({
		user: z.object({ id: z.string() }),
	}),
	body: z.object({
		storeId: z.uuid().optional(),
		targetUserIds: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
		title: z.string().min(1).max(200),
		content: z.string().min(1),
		category: z.enum(NotificationCategory),
		important: z.boolean().default(false),
		pushEnabled: z.boolean().default(true),
		emailEnabled: z.boolean().default(false),
		contentType: z.string().default('text/plain'),
		payload: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).optional(),
		scheduledAt: z.stringToDate().optional(),
	}),
})

@injectable()
export class SendNotificationController extends Controller<
	typeof SendNotificationControllerInputSchema,
	typeof SendNotificationControllerOutputSchema
> {
	readonly path = '/notifications'
	readonly method = 'post' as const
	readonly description = 'Send a notification (C53 SendNotification)'
	readonly inputSchema = SendNotificationControllerInputSchema
	readonly outputSchema = SendNotificationControllerOutputSchema

	override middlewares = [AuthAccountMiddleware]

	constructor(private cmd: SendNotification) {
		super()
	}

	async handle(request: this['input']): Promise<this['output']> {
		const data = await this.cmd.execute({
			userId: request.ctx.user.id,
			storeId: request.body.storeId,
			targetUserIds: request.body.targetUserIds,
			title: request.body.title,
			content: request.body.content,
			category: request.body.category,
			important: request.body.important,
			pushEnabled: request.body.pushEnabled,
			emailEnabled: request.body.emailEnabled,
			contentType: request.body.contentType,
			payload: request.body.payload,
			scheduledAt: request.body.scheduledAt,
		})
		return { status: HttpStatusCode.CREATED, data }
	}
}

import { Repository } from '@bk-dash/core-typescript'
import type { Transaction } from '@bk-dash/core-typescript'
import type { PlatformProps } from '@integration/services'
import { StoreIntegration } from '../../entities/StoreIntegration'

export abstract class StoreIntegrationRepository extends Repository<StoreIntegration> {
	abstract findById(id: string, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration | undefined>

	/** All integrations for a Store — backs T11 IntegrationsList + the disable-cascade. */
	abstract findByStoreId(storeId: string, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration[]>

	/**
	 * Existing integration for `(storeId, type, platform)` regardless of
	 * externalId. Backs C21's "is this provider already connected to this
	 * store?" guard so we don't end up with two SHOPIFY rows on the same store.
	 */
	abstract findByStoreIdAndPlatform(storeId: string, platform: PlatformProps, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration | undefined>

	/**
	 * Lookup by the natural (platform, externalId) tuple — backs Go-published
	 * integration event handlers (handshake_succeeded/failed, last_sync_updated)
	 * that arrive without storeIntegrationId since the producing side speaks
	 * the provider's vocabulary. The store_integrations unique index
	 * guarantees at most one row per (platform, externalId).
	 */
	abstract findByPlatformAndExternalId(platform: string, externalId: string, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration | undefined>

	/**
	 * Lookup by the provider's stable external id alone — backs marketing
	 * discovery event handlers (MarketingBusinessAccountDiscovered /
	 * MarketingAdAccountDiscovered) where the Go worker only knows the
	 * StoreIntegration's externalId, not the platform discriminator.
	 *
	 * Returns null (not undefined) to match the handler's explicit nil check.
	 * Use only when the externalId is known to be globally unique in context
	 * (e.g. the Go worker embeds `storeIntegrationExternalId` from the row
	 * it already resolved).
	 */
	abstract findByExternalId(externalId: string, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration | null>
}

import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'bun:test'
import { container, type DependencyContainer } from 'tsyringe-neo'
import { TestBed, testId } from '@test/support'
import { ExternalMediator, InternalMediator, MockOutboxDispatcher, SpyMediator } from '@bk-dash/core-typescript'
import { CurrencyCode, PaymentStatus } from '@bk-dash/contracts-typescript/wire/enums'
import { MonetaryAmount } from '@shared/objects'
import { UpdateOrderOverride } from '@sales/usecases/UpdateOrderOverride'
import { OrderOverriddenIntegrationPublisherHandler } from '@sales/handlers/OrderOverriddenPublisher'
import { MockOrderOverrideRepository, OrderOverrideRepository } from '@sales/repositories/OrderOverrideRepository'

const STORE = testId('store', '1')
const ORDER = testId('order', '1')
const EXT = 'shop-a.myshopify.com'
const USER = testId('user', '1')

/**
 * Flow test — saga across UpdateOrderOverride → outbox → internal
 * mediator → OrderOverriddenIntegrationPublisherHandler bridge → external
 * mediator publishes integration.shared.order.overridden.
 *
 * Verifies the WHOLE chain wires correctly in-process. Use-case-level
 * tests in src/sales/usecases/UpdateOrderOverride.test.ts cover the
 * domain-event persistence; this test covers the dispatcher + bridge
 * step that turns the in-process event into the cross-BC integration
 * event Analytics consumes.
 */
describe('FLOW: manual override → integration.shared.order.overridden', () => {
	let testBed: TestBed
	let testContainer: DependencyContainer
	let useCase: UpdateOrderOverride
	let externalSpy: SpyMediator
	let outbox: MockOutboxDispatcher
	let internalMediator: InternalMediator
	let overrideRepo: OrderOverrideRepository

	beforeAll(async () => {
		testContainer = container.createChildContainer()
		testBed = await TestBed.create('mock', { testContainer })
		useCase = testBed.resolve(UpdateOrderOverride)
		externalSpy = testContainer.resolve(ExternalMediator as any) as SpyMediator
		outbox = testContainer.resolve(MockOutboxDispatcher as any) as MockOutboxDispatcher
		internalMediator = testContainer.resolve(InternalMediator as any) as InternalMediator
		overrideRepo = testBed.resolve(OrderOverrideRepository)

		const bridge = testBed.resolve(OrderOverriddenIntegrationPublisherHandler)
		internalMediator.register(bridge)
	})
	beforeEach(async () => {
		await testBed.reset()
		;(overrideRepo as MockOrderOverrideRepository).clear()
	})
	afterAll(async () => {
		await testBed.destroy()
	})

	it('publishes a single integration event with the full entity snapshot when the override is created', async () => {
		await useCase.execute({
			userId: USER,
			storeId: STORE,
			orderIds: [ORDER],
			storeIntegrationExternalId: EXT,
			patch: {
				paymentStatus: PaymentStatus.PAID,
				revenue: new MonetaryAmount({ amountCents: 10_000, currency: CurrencyCode.USD }),
			},
		})

		await outbox.flush()

		const published = externalSpy.getPublished()
		expect(published).toHaveLength(1)
		const evt = published[0] as { name: string; payload: { orderId: string; storeIntegrationExternalId: string; entity: unknown } }
		expect(evt.name).toBe('integration.shared.order.overridden')
		expect(evt.payload.orderId).toBe(ORDER)
		expect(evt.payload.storeIntegrationExternalId).toBe(EXT)
		expect(evt.payload.entity).toBeDefined()
	})

	it('does not re-publish when the second patch matches existing fields (no-op)', async () => {
		await useCase.execute({
			userId: USER,
			storeId: STORE,
			orderIds: [ORDER],
			storeIntegrationExternalId: EXT,
			patch: { paymentStatus: PaymentStatus.PAID },
		})
		await outbox.flush()
		expect(externalSpy.getPublished()).toHaveLength(1)

		await useCase.execute({
			userId: USER,
			storeId: STORE,
			orderIds: [ORDER],
			storeIntegrationExternalId: EXT,
			patch: { paymentStatus: PaymentStatus.PAID }, // same fields — UpdateOrderOverride is a no-op, so no new event
		})
		await outbox.flush()
		expect(externalSpy.getPublished()).toHaveLength(1) // no-op patch emits nothing through the bridge
	})
})

import { Repository } from '@bk-dash/core-typescript'
import type { Transaction } from '@bk-dash/core-typescript'
import type { PlatformProps } from '@integration/services'
import { StoreIntegration } from '../../entities/StoreIntegration'

export abstract class StoreIntegrationRepository extends Repository<StoreIntegration> {
	abstract findById(id: string, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration | undefined>

	/** All integrations for a Store — backs T11 IntegrationsList + the disable-cascade. */
	abstract findByStoreId(storeId: string, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration[]>

	/**
	 * Existing integration for `(storeId, type, platform)` regardless of
	 * externalId. Backs C21's "is this provider already connected to this
	 * store?" guard so we don't end up with two SHOPIFY rows on the same store.
	 */
	abstract findByStoreIdAndPlatform(storeId: string, platform: PlatformProps, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration | undefined>

	/**
	 * Lookup by the natural (platform, externalId) tuple — backs Go-published
	 * integration event handlers (handshake_succeeded/failed, last_sync_updated)
	 * that arrive without storeIntegrationId since the producing side speaks
	 * the provider's vocabulary. The store_integrations unique index
	 * guarantees at most one row per (platform, externalId).
	 */
	abstract findByPlatformAndExternalId(platform: string, externalId: string, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration | undefined>

	/**
	 * Lookup by the provider's stable external id alone — backs marketing
	 * discovery event handlers (MarketingBusinessAccountDiscovered /
	 * MarketingAdAccountDiscovered) where the Go worker only knows the
	 * StoreIntegration's externalId, not the platform discriminator.
	 *
	 * Returns null (not undefined) to match the handler's explicit nil check.
	 * Use only when the externalId is known to be globally unique in context
	 * (e.g. the Go worker embeds `storeIntegrationExternalId` from the row
	 * it already resolved).
	 */
	abstract findByExternalId(externalId: string, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration | null>
}

import { HttpStatusCode, registerErrorCodes } from '@bk-dash/core-typescript'
import type { BaseDomainErrors, BaseApplicationErrors, BaseInterfaceErrors, BaseInfrastructureErrors } from '@bk-dash/core-typescript'

// ─── Domain Errors ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Raised by entities / value objects when a business invariant is violated.

export type CatalogDomainErrors =
	/** Two ProductCost rules overlap on the same (variantId × storeIntegrationId × currency × country × dateRange × qty modifier). */
	| 'PRODUCT_COST_RULE_OVERLAP'
	/** Attempted to change scoping keys (variantId, storeIntegrationId, currency, country, dateRange, qty) on an existing ProductCost — scoping is immutable. */
	| 'PRODUCT_COST_SCOPE_LOCKED'
	/** StartDate is after endDate in a ProductCostOption's date range. */
	| 'INVALID_DATE_RANGE'
	/** A tag value exceeds the 100-character maximum. */
	| 'TAG_TOO_LONG'
	/** CSV content cannot be parsed (malformed, wrong schema). */
	| 'CSV_PARSE_ERROR'
	/** Spec rule: at most one ProductCost per (storeId, productId). */
	| 'PRODUCT_COST_ALREADY_EXISTS'

export type DomainErrors = BaseDomainErrors | CatalogDomainErrors

// ─── Application Errors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Raised by use cases when orchestration fails (lookup failure, auth, quotas).

export type CatalogApplicationErrors =
	| 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND'
	| 'PRODUCT_VARIANT_NOT_FOUND'
	| 'PRODUCT_COST_NOT_FOUND'
	/** The referenced StoreIntegration does not exist or belongs to a different Store. */
	| 'STORE_INTEGRATION_NOT_FOUND'
	| CatalogCsvImportErrors

export type ApplicationErrors = BaseApplicationErrors | CatalogApplicationErrors

// ─── CSV Import Errors ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Per-row failure codes for BulkImportProductCostsFromCsv. Collected into the
// command's partial-success `errors[]` (typed, never a loose message); the few
// fatal codes (CSV_EMPTY / CSV_MISSING_REQUIRED_COLUMN) are returned as a row-0
// entry. Registered BAD_REQUEST so any future throw resolves correctly.
export type CatalogCsvImportErrors =
	| 'CSV_EMPTY'
	| 'CSV_MISSING_REQUIRED_COLUMN'
	| 'CSV_INVALID_PRODUCT_ID'
	| 'CSV_INVALID_CURRENCY'
	| 'CSV_INVALID_COUNTRY'
	| 'CSV_INVALID_START_DATE'
	| 'CSV_INVALID_END_DATE'
	| 'CSV_VARIANT_IDS_REQUIRED'
	| 'CSV_INVALID_VARIANT_ID'
	| 'CSV_INVALID_QUANTITY'
	| 'CSV_INVALID_QUANTITY_MODIFIER'
	| 'CSV_INVALID_UNIT_COST'
	| 'CSV_INVALID_SHIPPING'
	| 'CSV_INVALID_COST_TYPE'
	| 'CSV_MISSING_COST'
	| 'CSV_INVALID_COST'
	| 'CSV_DISPLAY_NAME_TOO_LONG'
	| 'CSV_MISSING_HANDLE'
	| 'CSV_UNKNOWN_HANDLE'
	| 'CSV_BLANK_VARIANT_NAME'
	| 'CSV_UNRESOLVED_VARIANT'
	| 'CSV_ROW_INVALID'

// ─── Interface / Infrastructure Errors ───────────────────────────────────────
export type CatalogInterfaceErrors = never
export type InterfaceErrors = BaseInterfaceErrors | CatalogInterfaceErrors

export type CatalogInfrastructureErrors = never
export type InfrastructureErrors = BaseInfrastructureErrors | CatalogInfrastructureErrors

export type Errors = ApplicationErrors | DomainErrors | InfrastructureErrors | InterfaceErrors

// ─── HTTP Status Registration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

import { Repository } from '@bk-dash/core-typescript'
import type { Transaction } from '@bk-dash/core-typescript'
import type { PlatformProps } from '@integration/services'
import { StoreIntegration } from '../../entities/StoreIntegration'

export abstract class StoreIntegrationRepository extends Repository<StoreIntegration> {
	abstract findById(id: string, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration | undefined>

	/** All integrations for a Store — backs T11 IntegrationsList + the disable-cascade. */
	abstract findByStoreId(storeId: string, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration[]>

	/**
	 * Existing integration for `(storeId, type, platform)` regardless of
	 * externalId. Backs C21's "is this provider already connected to this
	 * store?" guard so we don't end up with two SHOPIFY rows on the same store.
	 */
	abstract findByStoreIdAndPlatform(storeId: string, platform: PlatformProps, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration | undefined>

	/**
	 * Lookup by the natural (platform, externalId) tuple — backs Go-published
	 * integration event handlers (handshake_succeeded/failed, last_sync_updated)
	 * that arrive without storeIntegrationId since the producing side speaks
	 * the provider's vocabulary. The store_integrations unique index
	 * guarantees at most one row per (platform, externalId).
	 */
	abstract findByPlatformAndExternalId(platform: string, externalId: string, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration | undefined>

	/**
	 * Lookup by the provider's stable external id alone — backs marketing
	 * discovery event handlers (MarketingBusinessAccountDiscovered /
	 * MarketingAdAccountDiscovered) where the Go worker only knows the
	 * StoreIntegration's externalId, not the platform discriminator.
	 *
	 * Returns null (not undefined) to match the handler's explicit nil check.
	 * Use only when the externalId is known to be globally unique in context
	 * (e.g. the Go worker embeds `storeIntegrationExternalId` from the row
	 * it already resolved).
	 */
	abstract findByExternalId(externalId: string, tx?: Transaction): Promise<StoreIntegration | null>
}

import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'bun:test'
import { container, type DependencyContainer } from 'tsyringe-neo'
import { TestBed, testId } from '@test/support'
import { ExternalMediator, InternalMediator, MockOutboxDispatcher, SpyMediator } from '@bk-dash/core-typescript'
import { CurrencyCode, PaymentStatus } from '@bk-dash/contracts-typescript/wire/enums'
import { MonetaryAmount } from '@shared/objects'
import { UpdateOrderOverride } from '@sales/usecases/UpdateOrderOverride'
import { OrderOverriddenIntegrationPublisherHandler } from '@sales/handlers/OrderOverriddenPublisher'
import { MockOrderOverrideRepository, OrderOverrideRepository } from '@sales/repositories/OrderOverrideRepository'

const STORE = testId('store', '1')
const ORDER = testId('order', '1')
const EXT = 'shop-a.myshopify.com'
const USER = testId('user', '1')

/**
 * Flow test — saga across UpdateOrderOverride → outbox → internal
 * mediator → OrderOverriddenIntegrationPublisherHandler bridge → external
 * mediator publishes integration.shared.order.overridden.
 *
 * Verifies the WHOLE chain wires correctly in-process. Use-case-level
 * tests in src/sales/usecases/UpdateOrderOverride.test.ts cover the
 * domain-event persistence; this test covers the dispatcher + bridge
 * step that turns the in-process event into the cross-BC integration
 * event Analytics consumes.
 */
describe('FLOW: manual override → integration.shared.order.overridden', () => {
	let testBed: TestBed
	let testContainer: DependencyContainer
	let useCase: UpdateOrderOverride
	let externalSpy: SpyMediator
	let outbox: MockOutboxDispatcher
	let internalMediator: InternalMediator
	let overrideRepo: OrderOverrideRepository

	beforeAll(async () => {
		testContainer = container.createChildContainer()
		testBed = await TestBed.create('mock', { testContainer })
		useCase = testBed.resolve(UpdateOrderOverride)
		externalSpy = testContainer.resolve(ExternalMediator as any) as SpyMediator
		outbox = testContainer.resolve(MockOutboxDispatcher as any) as MockOutboxDispatcher
		internalMediator = testContainer.resolve(InternalMediator as any) as InternalMediator
		overrideRepo = testBed.resolve(OrderOverrideRepository)

		const bridge = testBed.resolve(OrderOverriddenIntegrationPublisherHandler)
		internalMediator.register(bridge)
	})
	beforeEach(async () => {
		await testBed.reset()
		;(overrideRepo as MockOrderOverrideRepository).clear()
	})
	afterAll(async () => {
		await testBed.destroy()
	})

	it('publishes a single integration event with the full entity snapshot when the override is created', async () => {
		await useCase.execute({
			userId: USER,
			storeId: STORE,
			orderIds: [ORDER],
			storeIntegrationExternalId: EXT,
			patch: {
				paymentStatus: PaymentStatus.PAID,
				revenue: new MonetaryAmount({ amountCents: 10_000, currency: CurrencyCode.USD }),
			},
		})

		await outbox.flush()

		const published = externalSpy.getPublished()
		expect(published).toHaveLength(1)
		const evt = published[0] as { name: string; payload: { orderId: string; storeIntegrationExternalId: string; entity: unknown } }
		expect(evt.name).toBe('integration.shared.order.overridden')
		expect(evt.payload.orderId).toBe(ORDER)
		expect(evt.payload.storeIntegrationExternalId).toBe(EXT)
		expect(evt.payload.entity).toBeDefined()
	})

	it('does not re-publish when the second patch matches existing fields (no-op)', async () => {
		await useCase.execute({
			userId: USER,
			storeId: STORE,
			orderIds: [ORDER],
			storeIntegrationExternalId: EXT,
			patch: { paymentStatus: PaymentStatus.PAID },
		})
		await outbox.flush()
		expect(externalSpy.getPublished()).toHaveLength(1)

		await useCase.execute({
			userId: USER,
			storeId: STORE,
			orderIds: [ORDER],
			storeIntegrationExternalId: EXT,
			patch: { paymentStatus: PaymentStatus.PAID }, // same fields — UpdateOrderOverride is a no-op, so no new event
		})
		await outbox.flush()
		expect(externalSpy.getPublished()).toHaveLength(1) // no-op patch emits nothing through the bridge
	})
})

## Renames (controller file `XController.ts` → `X.ts`, class name unchanged)

- `controllers/UnbindCampaignFromProductController.ts` → `controllers/UnbindCampaignFromProduct.ts`
- `controllers/ReconcileMarketingAccountsController.ts` → `controllers/ReconcileMarketingAccounts.ts`
- `controllers/DeleteManualAdSpendController.ts` → `controllers/DeleteManualAdSpend.ts`
- `controllers/UpdateManualAdSpendController.ts` → `controllers/UpdateManualAdSpend.ts`

## Item 14 — RecordManualAdSpend → CreateManualAdSpend
- New usecase `usecases/CreateManualAdSpend.ts` (class `CreateManualAdSpend`, `name: 'create_manual_ad_spend'`); deleted `usecases/RecordManualAdSpend.ts`.
- New controller `controllers/CreateManualAdSpend.ts` (class `CreateManualAdSpendController`, path `POST /manual-ad-spend`); deleted `controllers/RecordManualAdSpendController.ts`.
- Domain event class kept as `ManualAdSpendRecordedEvent` (event name untouched — only the command renamed).

## Item 15 — PatchAdAccounts → UpdateAdAccounts (RenameAdProfile folded in)
- New usecase `usecases/UpdateAdAccounts.ts` (class `UpdateAdAccounts`, `name: 'update_ad_accounts'`); input `{ storeId, updates: [{ id, active?, name? }] }`. Deleted `usecases/PatchAdAccounts.ts` and `usecases/RenameAdProfile.ts`.
- New controller `controllers/UpdateAdAccounts.ts` (class `UpdateAdAccountsController`, path `PATCH /marketing/ad-accounts`, body `{ updates: [...] }`). Deleted `controllers/PatchAdAccountsController.ts` and `controllers/RenameAdProfileController.ts`.

## Item 3 — bulk-by-ids
- `DeleteManualAdSpend`: input now `{ userId, ids: z.array(z.uuid()).min(1) }`; loops findById → emit `ManualAdSpendDeletedEvent` per row → delete; throws `AD_SPEND_NOT_FOUND` per missing id. Controller `DELETE /manual-ad-spend`, body `{ ids }`.
- `UpdateManualAdSpend`: input now `{ userId, ids: z.array(z.uuid()).min(1), ...patch }`; loops findById → applies patch → save → one `ManualAdSpendUpdatedEvent` per row. Controller `PATCH /manual-ad-spend`, body `{ ids, ...patch }`.

## Item 2 — middleware / ctx convention
- All store-scoped controllers (`BindCampaignToProduct`, `UnbindCampaignFromProduct`, `ReconcileMarketingAccounts`, `CreateManualAdSpend`, `UpdateAdAccounts`) now use `ctx: { user: { id }, session: { storeId: z.uuid() } }`, read `request.ctx.session.storeId`, and import `RequireStoreMember` from `@tenancy/middlewares/RequireStoreMember`. Middlewares stay `[AuthAccountMiddleware, RequireStoreMember]`.
- `Delete`/`UpdateManualAdSpend` controllers operate on ids only (no integration/store derivation needed) and retain their existing non-store-scoped ctx `{ user: { id } }` + `[AuthAccountMiddleware]`, as in the originals.

## Barrels & tests updated
- `controllers/index.ts` and `usecases/index.ts` re-exports updated to bare paths and new symbol names (`CreateManualAdSpend*`, `UpdateAdAccounts*`); dropped `RecordManualAdSpend*`, `PatchAdAccounts*`, `RenameAdProfile*`.
- `usecases/ManualAdSpend.test.ts`: import + resolve `CreateManualAdSpend`, describe title `CreateManualAdSpend (C33)`, and all update/delete calls switched to `ids: [...]`.

## Results
- `bun x tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit | grep 'src/marketing/'` → empty (clean).
- `bun test src/marketing/` → 70 pass, 0 fail (13 files).
- Did not run `bun sdk`. Only touched `src/marketing/`.

Note: a non-fatal DI warning ("Cannot inject ... Client" for `ReconcileMarketingAccountsController`) is logged during `index.test.ts` router build because the SDK `Client` token isn't bound in the test DI environment — pre-existing, unrelated to this refactor, and the test still passes.

File `GetPlatformDescriptorsController.ts` → `ListPlatformDescriptors.ts`; class `GetPlatformDescriptorsController` → `ListPlatformDescriptorsController`; schemas `Get…InputSchema/OutputSchema` → `List…`; barrel export updated. Removed controller (`ToggleIntegrationActiveController.ts`), usecase (`ToggleIntegrationActive.ts`), test (`ToggleIntegrationActive.test.ts`), and both barrel exports (controllers + usecases). No registry/module reference existed (controllers auto-register via `import * as controllers`). The `StoreIntegration` entity's `toggleActive()` method is left intact (still used by `TriggerReintegration.test.ts` and event flows). No external references anywhere.

### Rule 2 — session.storeId on store-scoped controllers (Connect / Disconnect / Reintegrate)
Fixed the broken `@auth/middlewares/RequireStoreMember` import → `@tenancy/middlewares/RequireStoreMember` on all touched controllers (the file moved in phase B; the old path no longer resolves).
- **ConnectIntegration** — ctx `membership: {storeId}` → `session: {storeId}`; handle reads `request.ctx.session.storeId` (already passed `storeId` to usecase).

Usecase `DisconnectIntegrationInputSchema` gained `storeId: z.uuid()` and a tenant-scope guard: `integration === undefined || integration.storeId.value !== input.storeId → STORE_INTEGRATION_NOT_FOUND`. (`integrationId` stays as the `:integrationId` path param — it's the resource id, not the store coordinate.)

Both gates pass. Here is the report.

## Tenancy refactor — complete

**Gates:** `bun x tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit | grep 'src/tenancy/'` → empty (clean). `bun test src/tenancy/` → 156 pass, 0 fail.

### Rule 1 (filename suffix)
N/A — all tenancy controllers already use bare filenames. Class names unchanged throughout.

### Rule 2 (middleware / ctx convention)
Every store-scoped controller now: ctx = `{ user: { id }, session: { storeId: z.uuid() } }`, reads `request.ctx.session.storeId` → passes as `storeId` to the usecase, dropped `storeId` from params/path, imports `RequireStoreMember` from `@tenancy/middlewares/RequireStoreMember`. None needed a StoreIntegration lookup.

| Controller | path change | middlewares |
|---|---|---|
| `ChangeStoreSubscription` | `/stores/:storeId/change-subscription` → `/stores/change-subscription`; added `[AuthAccountMiddleware, RequireStoreMember]` (was none); dropped `params.storeId`, moved fields to existing `body` | yes |
| `DisableStore` | `/stores/:storeId/disable` → `/stores/disable` | unchanged set, fixed import |
| `EnableStore` | `/stores/:storeId/enable` → `/stores/enable` | fixed import |
| `InviteMember` | `/stores/:storeId/memberships` → `/stores/memberships` | fixed import |
| `RemoveMember` | see rule 3 | fixed import |
| `ChangeMemberRole` | see rule 3 | fixed import |
| `UpdateStoreSettings` | `/stores/:storeId/settings` → `/stores/settings` | fixed import |

**Non-store-scoped (ctx untouched):** `CreateStore`, `AcceptInvitation`, `SetActiveStore` — these run before an active store exists, so they keep their existing ctx and `[AuthAccountMiddleware]`.

### Rule 3 (bulk by ids)
- **`RemoveMember`**: body now `{ ids: z.array(z.uuid()).min(1) }` (ids = userIds), path `/stores/memberships`, DELETE. Usecase loops; emits one `StoreMemberRemovedEvent` per member; LAST_OWNER guard tracked across the batch via a decrementing `ownersRemaining` counter. Output stays `{ removed: true }`.
- **`ChangeMemberRole`**: body now `{ ids: z.array(z.uuid()).min(1), newRole }`, path `/stores/memberships/role`, PATCH. Usecase loops; skips same-role no-ops; emits one `StoreMemberRoleChangedEvent` per actual change; CANNOT_DEMOTE_LAST_OWNER tracked across the batch. Output changed `{ changed: boolean }` → `z.void()`; controller now returns `NO_CONTENT`.

### Item 19 + 11 (merge Preferences → Settings)
- **Deleted:** `controllers/UpdateStorePreferences.ts`, `usecases/UpdateStorePreferences.ts`, `usecases/UpdateStorePreferences.test.ts`, `events/StorePreferencesUpdatedEvent.ts` (orphaned — only the deleted usecase referenced it).
- **Merged into `UpdateStoreSettings`:** controller + usecase now accept `reportingCurrency`, `timezone`, `showStoreNameInNotifications` alongside the profile fields. Usecase injects `OrderSamplingService`, calls both `store.updateSettings(...)` and `store.updatePreferences(..., { hasOrders })` (preserving the REPORTING_CURRENCY_LOCKED invariant), emits a single `StoreSettingsUpdatedEvent`.
- The merged preference behaviours were folded into `UpdateStoreSettings.test.ts` (timezone-when-hasOrders, currency-locked, showStoreName flip, combined update).

### Barrels / wiring updated
`controllers/index.ts`, `usecases/index.ts`, `events/index.ts`, `events/index.test.ts` (dropped the removed event + its assertion/case), `registry.ts` comment.

### Entity note
`Store.updatePreferences()` was **kept** (not folded into `updateSettings`) because `src/integration/services/shopify/ShopifyAdditionalPlatformHandler.ts` (another context) calls it directly. The merged usecase composes both entity methods.

### Out of scope / left as-is (per rule 4, touch only tenancy)
- `StorePreferencesCreatedEvent` retained — it is a distinct live event published by `CreateStore`, not part of the Update merge; renaming its wire name would be a contract change beyond this batch.
- A stale doc-comment in `src/sales/services/SalesOrderSamplingService.ts:14` still mentions "UpdateStorePreferences" — outside my context, non-load-bearing.
- Pre-existing repo-wide tsc errors in `finance/`, etc. (all referencing the not-yet-migrated `@auth/middlewares/RequireStoreMember`) are unrelated to tenancy and were not introduced by this change.

Did NOT run `bun sdk`.

Catalog refactor complete. Both gates pass: `bun x tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit | grep 'src/catalog/'` is empty, and `bun test src/catalog/` is 79 pass / 0 fail (13 files). Touched only the catalog context.

## Renames (controller class kept, file `XController.ts` → `X.ts`; barrel updated)
- `AddProductTagController.ts` → `AddProductTag.ts`
- `RemoveProductTagController.ts` → `RemoveProductTag.ts`
- `CreateProductCostController.ts` → `CreateProductCost.ts`
- `UpdateProductCostController.ts` → `UpdateProductCost.ts`
- `DeleteProductCostController.ts` → `DeleteProductCost.ts`
- `CreateKitController.ts` → `CreateKit.ts`
- `UpdateKitController.ts` → `UpdateKit.ts`
- `DeleteKitsController.ts` → `DeleteKit.ts` (also singularized: class `DeleteKitsController`→`DeleteKitController`, path stays `/catalog/kits`)
- `BulkImportProductCostsFromCsvController.ts` → `ImportProductCostsFromCsv.ts` (dropped "Bulk": class→`ImportProductCostsFromCsvController`, schemas, usecase, barrel)

Usecase renames: `DeleteKits`→`DeleteKit`, `BulkImportProductCostsFromCsv`→`ImportProductCostsFromCsv` (class + Input/Output schemas + `name` literal `delete_kit` / `import_product_costs_from_csv`). Usecase test renamed `BulkImportProductCostsFromCsv.test.ts` → `ImportProductCostsFromCsv.test.ts`.

## Deletions (item 4)
- `controllers/ImportProductCostShopiyController.ts`, `usecases/ImportProductCostShopify.ts`, and its barrel export — removed entirely (CSV import covers it). No test existed for it.

## Middleware / ctx convention (item 2)
- All store-scoped controllers (AddProductTag, RemoveProductTag, CreateKit, UpdateKit, DeleteKit, CreateProductCost, ImportProductCostsFromCsv) now import `RequireStoreMember` from `@tenancy/middlewares/RequireStoreMember`, set ctx to `{ user: {id}, session: {storeId: z.uuid()} }`, and read `request.ctx.session.storeId`. Middlewares stay `[AuthAccountMiddleware, RequireStoreMember]`.
- `CreateProductCost` and `ImportProductCostsFromCsv` dropped `storeIntegrationId` from the body; the **usecase** now injects `StoreIntegrationRepository` (`@integration/repositories`), derives the integration via `findByStoreId(storeId)`, and throws `STORE_INTEGRATION_NOT_FOUND` if none. CreateProductCost is now store-scoped (added `AuthAccountMiddleware`+`RequireStoreMember`; previously had only `RequireStoreMember`).
- Non-store-scoped DeleteProductCost / UpdateProductCost kept their existing `{ user: {id} }` ctx (no storeId).

## Bulk-by-ids (item 3)
- `DeleteProductCost`: controller body `{ ids: z.array(z.uuid()).min(1) }` (was param `productCostId`); path now `DELETE /product-costs`. Usecase loops ids, soft-deletes each, emits one `ProductCostDeletedEvent` per entity; missing/already-deleted fails the batch with `PRODUCT_COST_NOT_FOUND`.
- `UpdateProductCost`: controller body `{ ids[], options? }`; path now `PATCH /product-costs`. Usecase loops ids, applies the same `options` patch to each, emits one event per entity.
- `DeleteKit` (mock): body `{ ids: z.array(z.uuid()).min(1) }`.
- `UpdateKit`: **kept single** (`params.id` + patch) — bulk-patching distinct kits with one name/items payload doesn't make sense.

## Input reshapes
- CreateProductCost / UpdateProductCost input schemas already lacked `displayName`/`shipping` (removed from the entity in phase A) — confirmed no occurrences remain in those paths (`shipping` only survives on the Kit mocks, which model a kit's own field).
- CreateKit / UpdateKit already accept per-item `quantityModifier` (phase-A kit qty modifiers) — verified present.

## Tests updated
- `CreateProductCost.test.ts`, `UpdateProductCost.test.ts`, `DeleteProductCost.test.ts`, `ImportProductCostsFromCsv.test.ts`: removed `storeIntegrationId` args, seed the derived integration via `givenStoreIntegration(testBed, {storeId, ownerId})` in `beforeEach`, and converted `productCostId` → `ids: [...]` for Delete/Update. The SHOPIFY CSV test stamps its seeded products/variants with the derived integration's real id (+ `externalId`) so the Shopify processor resolves them.

Note: 3 repo-wide `tsconfig.build.json` errors remain in `finance` and `integration` contexts — pre-existing and outside catalog (not touched). Did not run `bun sdk`.

Finance context refactor complete. Both gates pass: `bun x tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit | grep 'src/finance/'` is empty, and `bun test src/finance/` → 85 pass / 0 fail.

## Renames (file → file, class/identifier changes)

**Item 1 — filename suffix drop (class names kept):**
- `controllers/CreateOperationalCostController.ts` → `CreateOperationalCost.ts`
- `controllers/CreateWarrantyReserveController.ts` → `CreateWarrantyReserve.ts`
- `controllers/DeleteOperationalCostController.ts` → `DeleteOperationalCost.ts`

- Barrel `controllers/index.ts` updated to bare import paths (kept `XController` export names).

**Item 8 — CaptureFxRates → UpdateFxRates:** controller file `CaptureFxRates.ts` → `UpdateFxRates.ts` (class `CaptureFxRatesController` → `UpdateFxRatesController`, path `/fx-rates/capture` POST → `/fx-rates` PUT); usecase `usecases/CaptureFxRates.ts` → `UpdateFxRates.ts` (class `CaptureFxRates` → `UpdateFxRates`, name `capture_fx_rates` → `update_fx_rates`, schemas `CaptureFxRates*Schema` → `UpdateFxRates*Schema`); barrels + `FxRate.test.ts` updated. Event `FxRateCapturedEvent` left unchanged.

**Item 9 — ResolveFxRate deleted:** removed `controllers/ResolveFxRateController.ts`, `usecases/ResolveFxRate.ts`, both barrel exports, and the ResolveFxRate `describe` block in `usecases/FxRate.test.ts`. (Orphan error code `FX_RATE_NOT_FOUND` left in `errors/index.ts` for the future FxRateService — out of scope to remove.)

**Item 10 — FeesConfiguration entity → Fees + UpdateFeesConfiguration → UpdateFees:**
- `entities/FeesConfiguration.ts` → `Fees.ts` (class `FeesConfiguration` → `Fees`, `FeesConfigurationSchema` → `FeesSchema`, `FeesConfigurationProps` → `FeesProps`); `entities/FeesConfiguration.test.ts` → `Fees.test.ts`.
- All entity-type references updated in: the three `FeesConfigurationRepository/*` files (kept the `FeesConfigurationRepository` class name + `feesConfiguration` drizzle table), `events/FeesConfigurationUpdatedEvent.ts` (import `FeesSchema`; kept event class/wire name), `usecases/UpdateFees.ts`, and both repo/usecase tests.
- usecase `usecases/UpdateFeesConfiguration.ts` → `UpdateFees.ts` (class/schemas/name → `UpdateFees`/`update_fees`); controller → `controllers/UpdateFees.ts` (class `UpdateFeesController`); `usecases/FeesConfiguration.test.ts` → `usecases/Fees.test.ts` (rewritten to the current `Fees` entity + `UpdateFees` shape — the old one was stale).
- Taxes left with no suffix (already had none).

## Bulk-by-ids reshape (item 3)
Singular command names kept; each now accepts `ids: z.array(z.uuid()).min(1)` and loops per-entity emitting one event each:
- `DeleteOperationalCost` (usecase + controller `DELETE /operational-costs` body `{ids}`)
- `DeleteWarrantyReserve` (usecase + controller `DELETE /warranty-reserves` body `{ids}`)
- `UpdateOperationalCost` (usecase + controller `PATCH /operational-costs` body `{ids, ...patch}`)
- `UpdateWarrantyReserve` (usecase + controller `PATCH /warranty-reserves` body `{ids, rate}`)
- Tests in `OperationalCost.test.ts` / `WarrantyReserve.test.ts` updated to `ids: [id]`.

## Middleware/ctx convention (item 2)
Store-scoped controllers now use `ctx: { user: { id }, session: { storeId: z.uuid() } }`, read `request.ctx.session.storeId`, and import `RequireStoreMember` from `@tenancy/middlewares/RequireStoreMember`: CreateOperationalCost, CreateWarrantyReserve, UpdateOperationalCost, DeleteOperationalCost, UpdateWarrantyReserve, DeleteWarrantyReserve, SetOperationalCostStatusOverride (added RequireStoreMember; kept its single `params.operationalCostId`), UpdateFees, UpdateTaxes (kept `RequireStoreRole`), UpsertWarranty. None of these usecases needed an integration, so no `StoreIntegrationRepository` was injected. Non-store-scoped controllers (`GetFxRates` read, `UpdateFxRates` scheduled-fetcher) kept their existing `{ user: { id } }` ctx + `[AuthAccountMiddleware]`.

## Incidental fixes required to make gates pass
- `Fees.ts`: typed `GatewayFeeInput.fixed.currency` as `CurrencyCode` (was `string`) — pre-existing build-tsc error.
- `DrizzleFeesConfigurationRepository.ts` `toDomain`: cast jsonb arrays via `Z.input<typeof FeesSchema>` instead of `unknown[]` — pre-existing build-tsc error.
- Stale assertion in `DrizzleFeesConfigurationRepository.test.ts` updated to the current per-platform `gatewayFees[].methods[...]` shape.

## Workspace-hygiene note (outside finance, not a content edit)
`packages/client/dist` generated SDK files (the `go/Client` bindings) were missing/deleted in the working tree, which broke every finance suite that transitively imports the SDK ("Cannot find module './go/Client'"). Per the worktree rule I restored them with `git checkout HEAD -- packages/client/dist` (did NOT run `bun sdk`). Several `M` finance files (`objects/GatewayFee.ts`, `objects/MarketingTax.ts`, `objects/index.ts`, `FxRateCapturedEvent.ts`, `DrizzleFxRateRepository.ts`, `GetFxRates.ts`) were already modified in the working tree before this task and were not touched by me.

import { injectable } from 'tsyringe-neo'
import { Controller, HttpStatusCode, z } from '@bk-dash/core-typescript'

import { MonetaryAmountSchema } from '../../shared/objects'
import { AuthAccountMiddleware } from '@auth/middlewares/AuthAccountMiddleware'
import { RequireStoreMember } from '@tenancy/middlewares/RequireStoreMember'
import { CreateOperationalCost, CreateOperationalCostOutputSchema } from '../usecases/CreateOperationalCost'
import { OperationalCostCategory, OperationalCostFlow, OperationalCostRecurrency } from '@bk-dash/contracts-typescript/wire/enums'

export const CreateOperationalCostControllerInputSchema = z.object({
	ctx: z.object({ user: z.object({ id: z.string() }), session: z.object({ storeId: z.uuid() }) }),
	body: z.object({
		category: z.enum(OperationalCostCategory),
		flow: z.enum(OperationalCostFlow).default(OperationalCostFlow.DEBIT),
		description: z.string().min(1).max(500),
		amount: MonetaryAmountSchema.refine(m => m.amountCents > 0),
		recurrency: z.enum(OperationalCostRecurrency),
		startDate: z.stringToDate(),
		endDate: z.stringToDate().optional(),
	}),
})

export const CreateOperationalCostControllerOutputSchema = CreateOperationalCostOutputSchema

@injectable()
export class CreateOperationalCostController extends Controller<
	typeof CreateOperationalCostControllerInputSchema,
	typeof CreateOperationalCostControllerOutputSchema
> {
	readonly path = '/operational-costs'
	readonly method = 'post' as const
	readonly description = 'Create recurring operational cost (C41)'
	readonly inputSchema = CreateOperationalCostControllerInputSchema
	readonly outputSchema = CreateOperationalCostControllerOutputSchema

	override middlewares = [AuthAccountMiddleware, RequireStoreMember]

	constructor(private cmd: CreateOperationalCost) {
		super()
	}

	async handle(request: this['input']): Promise<this['output']> {
		const data = await this.cmd.execute({
			userId: request.ctx.user.id,
			storeId: request.ctx.session.storeId,
			category: request.body.category,
			flow: request.body.flow,
			description: request.body.description,
			amount: request.body.amount,
			recurrency: request.body.recurrency,
			startDate: request.body.startDate,
			endDate: request.body.endDate,
		})
		return { status: HttpStatusCode.CREATED, data }
	}
}

import { injectable } from 'tsyringe-neo'
import { Controller, HttpStatusCode, z } from '@bk-dash/core-typescript'

import { AuthAccountMiddleware } from '@auth/middlewares/AuthAccountMiddleware'
import { SendNotification, SendNotificationOutputSchema } from '../usecases/SendNotification'
import { NotificationCategory } from '@bk-dash/contracts-typescript/wire/enums'

export const SendNotificationControllerInputSchema = z.object({
	ctx: z.object({
		user: z.object({ id: z.string() }),
	}),
	body: z.object({
		storeId: z.uuid().optional(),
		targetUserIds: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
		title: z.string().min(1).max(200),
		content: z.string().min(1),
		category: z.enum(NotificationCategory),
		important: z.boolean().default(false),
		pushEnabled: z.boolean().default(true),
		emailEnabled: z.boolean().default(false),
		contentType: z.string().default('text/plain'),
		payload: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).optional(),
		scheduledAt: z.stringToDate().optional(),
	}),
})

export const SendNotificationControllerOutputSchema = SendNotificationOutputSchema

@injectable()
export class SendNotificationController extends Controller<
	typeof SendNotificationControllerInputSchema,
	typeof SendNotificationControllerOutputSchema
> {
	readonly path = '/notifications'
	readonly method = 'post' as const
	readonly description = 'Send a notification (C53 SendNotification)'
	readonly inputSchema = SendNotificationControllerInputSchema
	readonly outputSchema = SendNotificationControllerOutputSchema

	override middlewares = [AuthAccountMiddleware]

	constructor(private cmd: SendNotification) {
		super()
	}

	async handle(request: this['input']): Promise<this['output']> {
		const data = await this.cmd.execute({
			userId: request.ctx.user.id,
			storeId: request.body.storeId,
			targetUserIds: request.body.targetUserIds,
			title: request.body.title,
			content: request.body.content,
			category: request.body.category,
			important: request.body.important,
			pushEnabled: request.body.pushEnabled,
			emailEnabled: request.body.emailEnabled,
			contentType: request.body.contentType,
			payload: request.body.payload,
			scheduledAt: request.body.scheduledAt,
		})
		return { status: HttpStatusCode.CREATED, data }
	}
}

import { MonetaryAmountSchema } from '../../shared/objects'
import { AuthAccountMiddleware } from '@auth/middlewares/AuthAccountMiddleware'
import { RequireStoreMember } from '@tenancy/middlewares/RequireStoreMember'
import { CreateOperationalCost, CreateOperationalCostOutputSchema } from '../usecases/CreateOperationalCost'
import { OperationalCostCategory, OperationalCostFlow, OperationalCostRecurrency } from '@bk-dash/contracts-typescript/wire/enums'

export const CreateOperationalCostControllerInputSchema = z.object({
	ctx: z.object({ user: z.object({ id: z.string() }), session: z.object({ storeId: z.uuid() }) }),
	body: z.object({
		category: z.enum(OperationalCostCategory),
		flow: z.enum(OperationalCostFlow).default(OperationalCostFlow.DEBIT),
		description: z.string().min(1).max(500),
		amount: MonetaryAmountSchema.refine(m => m.amountCents > 0),
		recurrency: z.enum(OperationalCostRecurrency),
		startDate: z.stringToDate(),
		endDate: z.stringToDate().optional(),
	}),
})

export const CreateOperationalCostControllerOutputSchema = CreateOperationalCostOutputSchema

@injectable()
export class CreateOperationalCostController extends Controller<
	typeof CreateOperationalCostControllerInputSchema,
	typeof CreateOperationalCostControllerOutputSchema
> {
	readonly path = '/operational-costs'
	readonly method = 'post' as const
	readonly description = 'Create recurring operational cost (C41)'
	readonly inputSchema = CreateOperationalCostControllerInputSchema
	readonly outputSchema = CreateOperationalCostControllerOutputSchema

	override middlewares = [AuthAccountMiddleware, RequireStoreMember]

	constructor(private cmd: CreateOperationalCost) {
		super()
	}

	async handle(request: this['input']): Promise<this['output']> {
		const data = await this.cmd.execute({
			userId: request.ctx.user.id,
			storeId: request.ctx.session.storeId,
			category: request.body.category,
			flow: request.body.flow,
			description: request.body.description,
			amount: request.body.amount,
			recurrency: request.body.recurrency,
			startDate: request.body.startDate,
			endDate: request.body.endDate,
		})
		return { status: HttpStatusCode.CREATED, data }
	}
}

import { injectable } from 'tsyringe-neo'
import { Controller, HttpStatusCode, z } from '@bk-dash/core-typescript'

import { AuthAccountMiddleware } from '@auth/middlewares/AuthAccountMiddleware'
import { SendNotification, SendNotificationOutputSchema } from '../usecases/SendNotification'
import { NotificationCategory } from '@bk-dash/contracts-typescript/wire/enums'

export const SendNotificationControllerInputSchema = z.object({
	ctx: z.object({
		user: z.object({ id: z.string() }),
	}),
	body: z.object({
		storeId: z.uuid().optional(),
		targetUserIds: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
		title: z.string().min(1).max(200),
		content: z.string().min(1),
		category: z.enum(NotificationCategory),
		important: z.boolean().default(false),
		pushEnabled: z.boolean().default(true),
		emailEnabled: z.boolean().default(false),
		contentType: z.string().default('text/plain'),
		payload: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).optional(),
		scheduledAt: z.stringToDate().optional(),
	}),
})

export const SendNotificationControllerOutputSchema = SendNotificationOutputSchema

@injectable()
export class SendNotificationController extends Controller<
	typeof SendNotificationControllerInputSchema,
	typeof SendNotificationControllerOutputSchema
> {
	readonly path = '/notifications'
	readonly method = 'post' as const
	readonly description = 'Send a notification (C53 SendNotification)'
	readonly inputSchema = SendNotificationControllerInputSchema
	readonly outputSchema = SendNotificationControllerOutputSchema

	override middlewares = [AuthAccountMiddleware]

	constructor(private cmd: SendNotification) {
		super()
	}

	async handle(request: this['input']): Promise<this['output']> {
		const data = await this.cmd.execute({
			userId: request.ctx.user.id,
			storeId: request.body.storeId,
			targetUserIds: request.body.targetUserIds,
			title: request.body.title,
			content: request.body.content,
			category: request.body.category,
			important: request.body.important,
			pushEnabled: request.body.pushEnabled,
			emailEnabled: request.body.emailEnabled,
			contentType: request.body.contentType,
			payload: request.body.payload,
			scheduledAt: request.body.scheduledAt,
		})
		return { status: HttpStatusCode.CREATED, data }
	}
}

## 1. The single most important pattern: Controller ↔ Use Case ↔ ctx

**A controller is a thin HTTP port. It does NOT re-declare schemas and does NOT carry scope ids in its body.**

### Input schema — COMPOSE from the use case, don't replicate

export const XControllerInputSchema = z.object({

  //        WITH only HTTP-coercion overrides via .extend (z.date()→z.stringToDate()).
  body: XInputSchema
    .omit({ userId: true, storeId: true /* + any param-derived id */ })
    .extend({ startDate: z.stringToDate(), endDate: z.stringToDate().optional() }),
})
export const XControllerOutputSchema = XOutputSchema   // reuse directly, never redeclare
```

---

## 3. The deleted read/query layer — and where the specs live

**All 51 read/query controllers + use cases were removed** (commit `289da16f` + a workflow). They were structurally wrong (client-supplied store ids, no ctx scoping, non-discriminated chart). - DB schema lives in `packages/contracts/db/schema/`; migrations in `packages/contracts/db/migrations/` (latest written: `0048_*`). Create with `cd packages/contracts && bun run drizzle:generate`; tests apply migrations in-process via PGlite.

## 1. The single most important pattern: Controller ↔ Use Case ↔ ctx

**A controller is a thin HTTP port. It does NOT re-declare schemas and does NOT carry scope ids in its body.**

### Input schema — COMPOSE from the use case, don't replicate
The use case owns the canonical input/output. Each use case exports `XInputSchema` (primitives: `z.uuid()`, `z.date()`, enums) and `XOutputSchema`. The controller derives its request body from the use case input:
```ts
export const XControllerInputSchema = z.object({
  ctx: z.object({ /* see §2 */ }),
  // body = use case input MINUS the fields the handler fills from ctx/params,
  //        WITH only HTTP-coercion overrides via .extend (z.date()→z.stringToDate()).
  body: XInputSchema
    .omit({ userId: true, storeId: true /* + any param-derived id */ })
    .extend({ startDate: z.stringToDate(), endDate: z.stringToDate().optional() }),
})
export const XControllerOutputSchema = XOutputSchema   // reuse directly, never redeclare
```
- Reference example: `src/finance/controllers/CreateOperationalCost.ts` vs `src/finance/usecases/CreateOperationalCost.ts`.
- `handle()` maps `request.ctx.*` + `body/params/query` → `usecase.execute({...})`.
- **Known exceptions where `.omit` doesn't apply** (left re-declared on purpose — keep them this way): use-case input that is a `z.discriminatedUnion` / `z.intersection` (`ImportProductCostsFromCsv`, `AuthorizeIntegration`); no-body controllers (`EnableStore`, `SetActiveStore`, `DuplicateLastGoal`, `UploadAvatar`, `GetPixelScriptSnippet`, `RemoveProductTag`); webhook `rawRequest: z.instanceof(Request)` (`HandleBillingWebhook`); query-based GET with `z.paginatedQuery` (`GetFxRates`); a deliberate field rename (`UpdateUserSettings`: controller `notificationCurrency` ↔ use case `customCurrency`).
- Controller `inputSchema` ctx keys are ONLY `ctx` / `body` / `query` / `params`.

### Schema layering rules (verify when touching schemas)
- **Entity / Value-Object schemas** use `z.instance(Id)` / `z.instance(MonetaryAmount)`. **Events / use-cases / controllers** use `z.uuid()` / primitives.
- Closed sets are **always** `z.enum(WireEnum)` from `@bk-dash/contracts-typescript/wire/enums` — never `z.string()` for an enumerable, never `z.nativeEnum`, never inline `z.enum(['a','b'])`.
- Money = `MonetaryAmountSchema` (`{ amountCents, currency }`) from `@shared/objects`. Shared schema vocabulary in `@shared/schemas` (note `src/shared/schemas/ui/` is now **orphaned** BFF read vocabulary kept for the read-layer rebuild — it has no consumers right now).

prompt:
You are picking up a polyglot DDD monorepo mid-refactor. This doc is your **context-gathering prompt**: read it, then verify each claim against the live code before acting (a second person — the repo owner "Gabriel" — commits to this same branch `feat/bk-dash-polyglot` in parallel, so treat specifics as "true as of last session, confirm in code"). Bun is at `~/.bun/bin` → start shells with `export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"`.

Repo root: `/Users/work/Desktop/Projetos/pessoal/template-fullstack`. Backend: `packages/api/typescript/src/<context>/…`. Contexts: `analytics, auth, billing, catalog, finance, identity, integration, marketing, notifications, sales, tenancy, tracking, shared`.

---

## 1. The single most important pattern: Controller ↔ Use Case ↔ ctx

**A controller is a thin HTTP port. It does NOT re-declare schemas and does NOT carry scope ids in its body.**

### Input schema — COMPOSE from the use case, don't replicate
The use case owns the canonical input/output. Each use case exports `XInputSchema` (primitives: `z.uuid()`, `z.date()`, enums) and `XOutputSchema`. The controller derives its request body from the use case input:
```ts
export const XControllerInputSchema = z.object({
  ctx: z.object({ /* see §2 */ }),
  // body = use case input MINUS the fields the handler fills from ctx/params,
  //        WITH only HTTP-coercion overrides via .extend (z.date()→z.stringToDate()).
  body: XInputSchema
    .omit({ userId: true, storeId: true /* + any param-derived id */ })
    .extend({ startDate: z.stringToDate(), endDate: z.stringToDate().optional() }),
})
export const XControllerOutputSchema = XOutputSchema   // reuse directly, never redeclare
```
- Reference example: `src/finance/controllers/CreateOperationalCost.ts` vs `src/finance/usecases/CreateOperationalCost.ts`.
- `handle()` maps `request.ctx.*` + `body/params/query` → `usecase.execute({...})`.
- **Known exceptions where `.omit` doesn't apply** (left re-declared on purpose — keep them this way): use-case input that is a `z.discriminatedUnion` / `z.intersection` (`ImportProductCostsFromCsv`, `AuthorizeIntegration`); no-body controllers (`EnableStore`, `SetActiveStore`, `DuplicateLastGoal`, `UploadAvatar`, `GetPixelScriptSnippet`, `RemoveProductTag`); webhook `rawRequest: z.instanceof(Request)` (`HandleBillingWebhook`); query-based GET with `z.paginatedQuery` (`GetFxRates`); a deliberate field rename (`UpdateUserSettings`: controller `notificationCurrency` ↔ use case `customCurrency`).
- Controller `inputSchema` ctx keys are ONLY `ctx` / `body` / `query` / `params`.

### Schema layering rules (verify when touching schemas)
- **Entity / Value-Object schemas** use `z.instance(Id)` / `z.instance(MonetaryAmount)`. **Events / use-cases / controllers** use `z.uuid()` / primitives.
- Closed sets are **always** `z.enum(WireEnum)` from `@bk-dash/contracts-typescript/wire/enums` — never `z.string()` for an enumerable, never `z.nativeEnum`, never inline `z.enum(['a','b'])`.
- Money = `MonetaryAmountSchema` (`{ amountCents, currency }`) from `@shared/objects`. Shared schema vocabulary in `@shared/schemas` (note `src/shared/schemas/ui/` is now **orphaned** BFF read vocabulary kept for the read-layer rebuild — it has no consumers right now).

---

## 2. Middlewares & where `storeId` comes from (CRITICAL)

**Rule the owner stated verbatim:** *"A controller / use case just needs the storeId from the session ctx. The middleware takes responsibility of ownership. If something needs the integration id, it is fetched inside the use case itself."*

- `AuthAccountMiddleware` (`src/auth/middlewares/`) validates the better-auth session and stamps:
  - `ctx.user = { id, email, name, emailVerified }`
  - `ctx.session = { id, userId, expiresAt, storeId }` where **`storeId` = the active store** (better-auth `session.activeStoreId`, nullable).
- `RequireStoreMember` **was MOVED to `src/tenancy/middlewares/`** (with `RequireStoreRole`). It checks `ctx.user.id` is a member of `ctx.session.storeId` (`StoreMembershipRepository.findByStoreAndUser`), throws `STORE_MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND` otherwise, and stamps `ctx.membership = { id, userId, role, storeIds }` (`storeIds` = all stores via `findByUserId`). Import it from `@tenancy/middlewares/RequireStoreMember`.
- **Controllers read `ctx.session.storeId`** (NOT `ctx.membership.storeId`). They no longer accept `storeIds` / `storeIntegrationIds` / `productIds` as request inputs.
- The canonical ctx schema is `ctx: z.object({ user: z.object({ id: z.string() }), session: z.object({ storeId: z.uuid() }) })`. **`user` is dropped from the ctx schema when the handler never reads `.user`** (14 controllers were trimmed; some, e.g. global `GetFxRates`/`UpdateFxRates`, ended at `ctx: z.object({})`). The auth middleware still runs regardless of what the schema declares.
- **Need an integration / external id?** Fetch it inside the use case from `storeId` via `StoreIntegrationRepository` (`src/integration/repositories/StoreIntegrationRepository`). e.g. item 18 `UpdateOrderOverride` derives `storeIntegrationExternalId` from the store; item 20 `GetPixelScriptSnippet` infers the **first `SALES_CHANNEL`** integration. Do NOT pass these from the client.

---

## 3. The deleted read/query layer — and where the specs live

**All 51 read/query controllers + use cases were removed** (commit `289da16f` + a workflow). They were structurally wrong (client-supplied store ids, no ctx scoping, non-discriminated chart). Only these reads remain: `GetFxRates` (finance), `ListPlatformDescriptors` (integration), `IntegrationOAuthCallback`, `GetPixelScriptSnippet` (tracking), `GetSession` (auth).

**The frontend-screen specs that those reads were meant to serve are the source of truth for rebuilding them:**
- `.specs/frontend-screens/SPECS_INDEX.md` — index of every screen + its controllers.
- `.specs/frontend-screens/_schema-fundamentals.md` — the shared read vocabulary (Metric, segmented, Kpis, breakdowns, income graph, recommended-apps…).
- `.specs/frontend-screens/<screen>/SPEC.md` — per-screen Controller Contract (dashboard `SPEC.md`, `orders/`, `products/`, `products/costs/`, `products/kits/`, `finance/costs/`, `marketing/traffic/`, `marketing/accounts/$platform/`, `settings/integrations/`, `settings/account/`, `settings/taxesAndFees/`, `suggestions/`, `tools/calculator/`).

**The rebuild blueprint:** `.plans/2026-06-03-read-layer-rebuild.md` — defines the planned (NOT yet built) waves:
- Wave 0 = the ctx/middleware reshape (the `RequireStoreMember`→tenancy + `ctx.session.storeId` part is DONE; the rest is the conventions in §2).
- Wave 1 = analytics rebuild from spec: `GetDashboardOverview`→**`GetDashboard`** (gone now; rebuild), `GetChart` as a **discriminated union by chart type** with type-appropriate buckets (weekday→`DayOfWeek`, region→`Country`, time→dates), a **`StoreScope { SINGLE_STORE, MULTI_STORE }`** query enum (single = `ctx.session.storeId`; multi = consolidated + perStore over `ctx.membership.storeIds`).
- Other plans worth reading: `.plans/2026-06-02-mocked-bff-controllers.md`, `.plans/2026-06-02-mock-controllers-refactor.md`, `.plans/phaseR1-conventions.md`.

When rebuilding a read: it's a **Query use case** (BFF, direct Drizzle, no entities) living in the owning context, conformed to §1/§2 (ctx-driven, no client store ids, composed controller schema).

---

## 4. Contracts (wire) enums — the cross-language source of truth

- TypeSpec at `packages/contracts/wire/enums/*.tsp` (+ `wire/main.tsp` imports) → generated TS `packages/contracts/generated/typescript/src/wire/enums/` + Go. Events at `wire/events/`.
- Regenerate: `cd packages/contracts && bun run tsp:compile && bun run codegen:wire`.
- **GOTCHA:** the codegen derives the TS enum member NAME from the **value** (`toTsEnumMember`), so enum values must be identifier-safe — no leading digits (`WarrantyPeriod` uses `DAYS_30="DAYS_30"`, not `"30"`).
- Reuse before creating; align names/values (incl. casing) to existing wire enums. `MarketingPlatform` real values are `META/GOOGLE_ADS/TIKTOK/TABOOLA` (not facebook/google).
- `FxRateSource` was **stripped** this session (enum + `fx-rate-captured` event field + the `fx_rates.source` DB column). FX rates are either created by us (manual) or pulled by an external service — no discriminator.
- DB schema lives in `packages/contracts/db/schema/`; migrations in `packages/contracts/db/migrations/` (latest written: `0048_*`). Create with `cd packages/contracts && bun run drizzle:generate`; tests apply migrations in-process via PGlite.

---

## 5. Build / verify / commit

- API type-check (authoritative): `cd packages/api/typescript && bun x tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit`.
- API tests: `cd packages/api/typescript && bun test` (PGlite in-process; ~1074 tests; the `mediator.register`/`redis down`/`RateLimitMiddleware` lines are pre-existing **noise**, not failures; a single occasional fail is flaky DI — re-run).
- Repo-wide tsc: `bun tsc` from root (proves the app/astro/expo/e2e compile against the SDK).
- **SDK regen (single writer):** `bun sdk` from root — rewrites `packages/client/dist/typescript` + `public/docs/openapi.json`. Run after any controller schema change.
- Lint: `bun lint` is **nx-affected** — touching a context surfaces that project's PRE-EXISTING lint debt (e.g. app-react `DataTable/types.ts`, `Navbar/index.tsx`); don't be alarmed, it's not yours.
- **Pre-commit hook needs bun on PATH** → always `export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"` before `git commit`, or it fails with `bunx: command not found`.

---

## 6. Conventions & owner preferences distilled this session

- **Bulk by ids:** every patch/delete command is SINGULAR-named but takes `ids: z.array(z.uuid()).min(1)` and loops per entity (one event per entity). `UpdateOrderOverride` is batch on `orderIds`.
- **Naming:** controller FILES drop the `Controller` suffix (`CreateGoal.ts`, class stays `CreateGoalController`). "Preferences"→"Settings". Drop redundant "Configuration"/"Settings" entity suffixes (`FeesConfiguration`→`Fees`). `Record/Capture`→`Create/Update` (`CreateManualAdSpend`, `UpdateFxRates`). Merge overlapping commands (`UpdateStorePreferences`+`UpdateStoreSettings`→one). Bulk-update controllers over single-toggle ones (`UpdateAdAccounts` folds in renaming; no `ToggleIntegrationActive`/`PatchAdAccounts`/`RenameAdProfile`).
- **Parallelism:** partition agents by **bounded context** — the only per-context shared file is `controllers/index.ts` + `usecases/index.ts` barrels, so one-agent-per-context = zero merge conflicts.
- **zsh gotcha:** unquoted `$var` does NOT word-split — use `while read` / arrays in loops.
- Stage specific files (never `git add -A`); the Go webhook work + `.claude/skills` edits in the tree are the owner's parallel WIP — leave them.

## 7. Where to start
1. Read this, then `.plans/2026-06-03-read-layer-rebuild.md` + `.specs/frontend-screens/_schema-fundamentals.md` + `SPECS_INDEX.md`.
2. Confirm current ctx/middleware shape: open `src/tenancy/middlewares/RequireStoreMember.ts`, `src/auth/middlewares/AuthAccountMiddleware.ts`, and any 2-3 controllers (`src/finance/controllers/CreateOperationalCost.ts`, `src/sales/controllers/UpdateOrderOverride.ts`).
3. `git log --oneline -15` to see the owner's concurrent Task-T work; `bun x tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit` to confirm HEAD is green before changing anything.

# BK Dash — Índice de Specs de Tela (`/app`)

Specs geradas a partir dos snapshots HTML em cada `*/htmls/`, usando a skill
**ui-composition** (seção `## UI Composition`) + um **Controller Contract** que consome o
vocabulário compartilhado em **[`_schema-fundamentals.md`](./_schema-fundamentals.md)**.

> **Leia primeiro [`_schema-fundamentals.md`](./_schema-fundamentals.md).** Define os átomos
> (`MetricSchema`, `Money`), enums (`CostKind`, `MarketingPlatform`, `PixelEventType`, …), a
> estrutura composeable `Segmented<Enum>` e as regras: _controllers retornam dados, não
> apresentação_; _um controller por preocupação_; _records tipados por enum/ID, não "rows"_.

## Telas

| Rota | Tela | SPEC | Sections | Components | Leaves | Dialogs | Forms |
|------|------|------|---------:|----------:|-------:|--------:|------:|
| `/app` | Dashboard | [SPEC](./SPEC.md) | 11 | 8 | 11 | 6 | 3 |
| `/app/orders` | Pedidos | [SPEC](./orders/SPEC.md) | 1 | 10 | 1 | 4 | 0 |
| `/app/products` | Produtos | [SPEC](./products/SPEC.md) | 2 | 3 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| `/app/products/costs` | Custos de Produto (lista) | [SPEC](./products/costs/SPEC.md) | 3 | 6 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| `/app/products/costs/$productId` | Custo de Produto (variantes) | [SPEC](./products/costs/$productId/SPEC.md) | 4 | 0 | 4 | 3 | 2 |
| `/app/products/kits` | Kits de Produtos | [SPEC](./products/kits/SPEC.md) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| `/app/finance/costs` | Custos Operacionais | [SPEC](./finance/costs/SPEC.md) | 2 | 6 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| `/app/marketing/traffic` | Tráfego / Anúncios | [SPEC](./marketing/traffic/SPEC.md) | 2 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| `/app/marketing/accounts/$platform` | Marketing por Plataforma | [SPEC](./marketing/accounts/$platform/SPEC.md) | 2 | 4 | 3 | 1 | 0 |
| `/app/settings/integrations` | Integrações | [SPEC](./settings/integrations/SPEC.md) | 2 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| `/app/settings/account` | Minha Conta | [SPEC](./settings/account/SPEC.md) | 4 | 6 | 0 | 2 | 3 |
| `/app/settings/taxesAndFees` | Impostos e Taxas | [SPEC](./settings/taxesAndFees/SPEC.md) | 4 | 4 | 0 | 0 | 4 |
| `/app/suggestions` | Sugestões | [SPEC](./suggestions/SPEC.md) | 2 | 3 | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| `/app/tools/calculator` | Calculadora | [SPEC](./tools/calculator/SPEC.md) | 1 | 5 | 2 | 0 | 1 |

## Registro Consolidado de Controllers

Todos os contratos consomem os schemas de `_schema-fundamentals.md` (Metric/Money/enums/Segmented).

### Já existentes (`api/src/ui/controllers/`) — reutilizar, **não** redefinir

| Controller | Path | Telas que consomem |
|-----------|------|--------------------|
| `GetDashboard` | GET `/ui/dashboard` | `/app` — **dividir** em `GetSingleStoreDashboard` (sessão) + `GetMultiStoreDashboard` (todas as lojas) |

## Decisões cross-tela

### Resolvidas pelos fundamentals

- ✅ **Enums de custo** — `CostKind` definido e usado em `CostBreakdownSchema`/`Segmented` (#9).
- ✅ **`ads.byPlatform`** — `Record<MarketingPlatform, Metric>`; **imposto separado** de `byType` (#5).
- ✅ **Breakdowns** — `gateway.{variable,fixed}` via `GatewayFeeSchema`; chargeback por `ChargebackStatus` (#2).
- ✅ **`perStore`** — `Record<StoreIntegrationId, KpisSchema>`; cada loja tem os mesmos KPIs (#2).
- ✅ **Custos adicionais** — cada tipo (chargeback/refund/taxes/operational) é **propriedade própria** em `DashboardDetailsSchema` (sem wrapper `AdditionalCostsSchema`), sem "rows"/`editable` (#7).
- ✅ **Métricas de anúncio** — `cpa`/`roi`/`roas` em `AdsBreakdownSchema`; `orders`/`averageTicket`/`unitsSold`/custos-por-categoria em `KpisSchema`.
- ✅ **QR do app** — `GetAppDownload.qrRedirectUrl` redireciona por User-Agent (iOS/Android).
- ✅ **Campos de apresentação** — `href`/`ordersHref`/`tooltip`/`label`/`color`/`icon` removidos; derivados no frontend (#1, #8).
- ✅ **`AddOperationalCost` vs `CreateOperationalCost`** — unificado em `CreateOperationalCost` (dono: `finance/costs`).
- ✅ **Dinheiro multi-moeda** — `CurrencyAmount` (= `CurrencyObj`/`TotalByCurrency` do backend) para agregados; `Money` para entradas mono-moeda.
- ✅ **Dashboard single vs multi-store** — `GetSingleStoreDashboard` (loja da sessão) e `GetMultiStoreDashboard` (todas as lojas ativas/integradas, agregado multi-moeda + `perStore`).
- ✅ **Contrato dos gráficos** — espelha o `GetIncomeGraph` existente do backend; cada bucket carrega a composição de custo (`revenue`/`profit`/`marketingCost`/`productCost`/`fees`/`taxes`). Enums `TimeFrequency`/`DayOfWeek`/`DayPeriod` adicionados.

### Em aberto

1. **`ListRecommendedApps` único** — proposto por 6 telas; manter **um** controller com parâmetro de
   contexto/categoria (path canônico: `GET /ui/bkdash/recommended-apps?context=…`).
2. **Commands de integração** — consolidar `Connect/Reintegrate/Disconnect` entre `settings/integrations`
   e `marketing/$platform` em um módulo único.
3. **Primitivo de gráfico (UI)** — o contrato de DADOS está resolvido (BFF espelha `GetIncomeGraph` do
   backend + recortes; `GetFunnel` por `PixelEventType`). Resta escolher a lib do primitive `Chart`
   (Recharts vs visx) antes do `/primitive`.
4. **Enums** — `MarketingPlatform` e `Currency` espelham o backend (Currency é ISO amplo: ARS/AUD/BRL/CAD/EUR/GBP/USD/…); confirmar membros finais de `MarketingPlatform`/`GoalType`. `ChartType` removido (substituído por `TimeFrequency` + recortes dedicados).

```ts
// section fragments (raw Zod shapes — compose by spread)

const STAT             = { stat: StatSchema }
const STAT_CONSOLIDATED = { stat: ConsolidatedStatSchema, perStore: z.record(StoreIntegrationId, StatSchema) }
const ORDERS           = { orders: OrdersSummarySchema }
const ORDERS_CONS      = { orders: ConsolidatedOrdersSummarySchema }
const DETAILS          = { details: DashboardDetailsSchema }
const DETAILS_CONS     = { details: ConsolidatedDashboardDetailsSchema }
const PAYMENT_METHODS  = { paymentMethods: PaymentMethodBreakdownSchema }

const variant = (kind, tenancyScope, dashboardMode, ...shapes) =>
  z.object({
    kind: z.literal(kind),
    tenancyScope: z.literal(tenancyScope),   // echoed for the frontend
    dashboardMode: z.literal(dashboardMode), // echoed for the frontend
    ...Object.assign({}, ...shapes),
  })

const SINGLE_GLOBAL   = variant('SINGLE_GLOBAL',   'SINGLE_STORE', 'GLOBAL',   STORE, STAT, ORDERS, DETAILS)
const SINGLE_NATIONAL = variant('SINGLE_NATIONAL', 'SINGLE_STORE', 'NATIONAL', STORE, STAT, ORDERS, DETAILS, PAYMENT_METHODS)
const MULTI_GLOBAL    = variant('MULTI_GLOBAL',    'MULTI_STORE',  'GLOBAL',   STAT_CONSOLIDATED, ORDERS_CONS, DETAILS_CONS)
const MULTI_NATIONAL  = variant('MULTI_NATIONAL',  'MULTI_STORE',  'NATIONAL', STAT_CONSOLIDATED, ORDERS_CONS, DETAILS_CONS, PAYMENT_METHODS)

export const GetDashboardOutputSchema =
  z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [SINGLE_GLOBAL, SINGLE_NATIONAL, MULTI_GLOBAL, MULTI_NATIONAL])
```
`kind` is the single Zod/OpenAPI discriminator (clean kubb mapping + exhaustive `never` narrowing); both real enums are

  controllers/SetStoreVisualization.ts           // command: upsert mode for ctx.session.storeId
  controllers/index.ts
  usecases/GetDashboard.ts                        // Query use case (faker)
  usecases/SetStoreVisualization.ts               // command use case (real persist)
