Query params `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate, productIds? }`.
- **useListQuickProductRanking** → `{ totalProducts: number, items: { productId, name, imageUrl: string|null, sales: Tally }[] }` (top 10). `sales.value` = revenue (money), `sales.count` = units sold.
- **useGetGoal** → `{ goal: { id, storeId, type:'REVENUE'|'PROFIT', targetAmount:{ amountCents, currency }, from, to } | null }`. Query `{}` (session store).
- **useGetGoalProgress** → `{ byType: { REVENUE?: { target:number, achieved:number, stores:[{storeId,storeName,target,achieved}] }, PROFIT?: {...} } }`. Query `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate }`.
- Mutations: **useCreateGoal**(`createGoalMutationRequestSchema`: `{ type, currency, targetAmount:{amountCents,currency}, from, to }` — check exact), **useUpdateGoal**(`{ goalId, data }`), **useCreateOperationalCost**(`createOperationalCostMutationRequestSchema`: `{ flow:'CREDIT'|'DEBIT', amount/currency, name, frequency, startDate, endDate?, category? }` — check exact), **useUpsertWarranty**(`upsertWarrantyMutationRequestSchema`: `{ percentage, startDate, periodDays }` — check exact). Invalidate the relevant query key on success; toast via `sonner`.

> Use the generated `*MutationRequestSchema` directly as TanStack Form `validators.onChange`. Inspect the exact request
> field names in the generated `…Schema.ts`/types before wiring (names above are best-effort).

## Form pattern (TanStack Form + SDK schema)
`useForm({ defaultValues, validators:{ onChange: <op>MutationRequestSchema }, onSubmit: async f => { const r = schema.safeParse(f.value); if(!r.success) return; await mutation.mutateAsync({ data: r.data }, { onSuccess, onSettled }) } })`. Submit gated via `form.Subscribe`. Drawers use `<Sheet>`; close on success.

## Storybook
CSF3 (`Meta`/`StoryObj`), `@storybook/react-vite`. NO QueryClient/MSW in preview → **only story leaf/prop-driven
components** (pass mock data as args) + skeleton/empty states. Do NOT story hook-owning Sections. Place stories at
`<Name>/stories/<Name>.stories.tsx` (or `<Name>/<Name>.stories.tsx`). Mirror `src/components/StatCard/StatCard.stories.tsx`.

---

# COMPONENTS (each agent: build ONE cluster under `-components/`, with leaf stories; DO NOT edit the route `index.tsx`)

## A) FunnelSection  (hook: useGetPixelFunnel)
Card spanning a row. 5 step columns + a right rail with 2 highlight cards.
- **FunnelStep** (leaf ×5): label (Page View / View Content / Add to Cart / Initiate Checkout / Purchase →
  PAGE_VIEWED, PRODUCT_VIEWED, PRODUCT_ADDED_TO_CART, CHECKOUT_STARTED, CHECKOUT_COMPLETED), big `%` (step.value/base.value),
  small "{count} de {base}" with a users icon, and a purple area/bar whose height ∝ the fraction (simple SVG/CSS, sloping
  down to the next step is decorative — a filled trapezoid is fine). Props: `{ label, pct, count, base }`. Story it.
- **FunnelHighlightCard** (leaf ×2): "Taxa de Conversão" (value=conversionRate %, delta) and "Carrinhos"
  (value=carts.value money, delta) — each: icon + label + info hint + big value + metric-delta. Props-driven. Story it.
- Empty state: `hasPixel === false` → show a "instalar Pixel" CTA instead of steps.

## B) AdditionalCostsSection  (hook: useGetDashboard, store: useDashboardStore)  + 2 drawers
Card. Header: money icon badge + "Custos Adicionais" + big total (sum of the rows below, derived). A **Checkbox**
"Descontar Custos Adicionais" bound to `useDashboardStore` (`discountAdditionalCosts` / `toggleDiscountAdditionalCosts`).
Separator. Rows (label + value in RED money): Chargeback (`details.chargeback.byStatus.total.value`), Reembolso
(`details.refund.value`), Impostos (`details.taxes.ads.value + details.taxes.others.value`), Operacional
(`details.operational.total.value`), Garantia (warranty — NO read hook yet → show "Sem Garantia" in green).
- Impostos / Operacional / Garantia rows each have a small purple **+** button.
  - Operacional **+** → opens **OperationalCostDrawer** (Sheet) — form via **useCreateOperationalCost** +
    `createOperationalCostMutationRequestSchema`. Fields: Saída/Entrada (flow checkboxes, exactly one), Valor
    (**MoneyInput**), Descrição (input), Frequência (Select), Data de Início (DatePicker), Categoria (Select). Title
    "Adicionar Custo Operacional".
  - Garantia **+** → opens **WarrantyDrawer** (Sheet) — form via **useUpsertWarranty** + its schema. Fields:
    Porcentagem de Garantia (% input), Data de Início (DatePicker), Período (Select e.g. "30 dias"). Submit "Editar Garantia".
  - Impostos **+** → link to `/app/settings/taxesAndFees` (no drawer provided) — use a Link/navigate; flag as follow-up.
- Story the leaf row (`AdditionalCostRow` with props label/value/tone/onAdd?) + the drawers' form bodies if practical.

## C) GoalSection  (hooks: useGetGoal + useGetGoalProgress)  + Goal drawer
Card. Header "Meta de Faturamento" + an edit **pencil** button (top-right) → opens **GoalDrawer**. Body: **Gauge**
(value = achieved/target capped 0..1) with big `%` centered; below: "{achievedMoney} de {targetMoney}" (achieved green,
target muted). Pick the active goal from `useGetGoal().goal`; type=goal.type → read `useGetGoalProgress().byType[goal.type]`
for `{ target, achieved }`. Empty: goal === null → "Nenhuma meta cadastrada" + a "criar meta" affordance opening the drawer.
- **GoalDrawer** (Sheet): form via **useCreateGoal** (or **useUpdateGoal** when editing an existing goal). Title
  "Meta de Faturamento". Fields: Meta (**MoneyInput**), Data de Início da Meta (DatePicker), Data de Fim da Meta
  (DatePicker), "Selecione o tipo da sua meta" → Faturamento/Lucro (REVENUE/PROFIT, two checkboxes/radio, exactly one).
  Submit "Editar Meta"/"Criar Meta". Prefill from the current goal when editing.
- Story the gauge-display leaf with mock `{ pct, achieved, target, currency }`.

## D) RankingSection  (hook: useListQuickProductRanking)
Card. Header: package icon badge + "Ranking" + big `{totalProducts}` + a "Ver Tudo" button → Link `/app/products`.
Separator. Scrollable list (max ~3.5 rows visible) of **RankingProductRow** (leaf ×N, top 10): square product image
(`imageUrl` or placeholder), name (truncate), `{salesValueMoney}` (sales.value.value), and "{salesCount} Vendido(s)"
(sales.count.value) right-aligned. Props-driven leaf. Story it (with image + placeholder variants).

# Dashboard frontend build — shared brief

App: `packages/app/react` (TanStack Start + Vite). Route: `src/routes/(app)/dashboard/`. Build components under
`routes/(app)/dashboard/-components/<Name>/`. Run shells with `export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"`.

## Conventions (HARD RULES)
- **Data ownership:** every Section/Component fetches its OWN data via SDK hooks. NO `data` prop from route/parent.
  Leaves rendered in a `.map()` receive the single item by prop and MUST NOT re-fetch. Search params via
  `getRouteApi('/(app)/dashboard/').useSearch()` (never props). Shared client state via the zustand store (never props).
- **Section** = container that owns a query + orchestrates a region; suffix `Section`; lives in `-components/`.
- **Skeleton inline:** static UI (headers/buttons) always visible; only the data area swaps to `<Skeleton/>`:
  `{data ? <Real/> : <Skeleton/>}`. Import `Skeleton` from `@/components/ui/skeleton`.
- **SDK import specifier:** `@bk-dash/client-typescript/typescript` (hooks, schemas `*MutationRequestSchema`, query keys
  `*QueryKey`, types). React Query dedupes — multiple components calling the same hook = one request.
- **i18n:** all visible text via `react-i18next` `useTranslation()` with keys under `dashboard.*`
  (`src/locales/pt.json` + `en.json`, typed by `@types/i18next.d.ts`). pt is the source language.
- **Verify:** `cd packages/app/react && bun x tsc --noEmit` + `bun run lint`. Stories: `bun run storybook:build`.

## Primitives (`@/components/ui/*`) — exist
`button, card, sheet (DRAWER), checkbox, switch, select, date-picker, input, input-group, label, field, skeleton,
separator, tooltip, badge, avatar, progress, dropdown-menu, popover, spinner, sonner` (+ `metric-delta`, `info-hint`,
`gradient-icon`, `gradient-icon-badge`).
- **Sheet/Drawer:** `import { Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetFooter, SheetClose } from '@/components/ui/sheet'`. `<SheetContent side="right">`. Trigger: `<SheetTrigger render={<Button/>} />`.
- **Checkbox:** `<Checkbox checked={v} onCheckedChange={setV} />` + `<Label htmlFor>` inside `<Field orientation="horizontal">`.
- **Select:** `Select/SelectTrigger/SelectValue/SelectContent/SelectItem` (value/onValueChange).
- **DatePicker:** `<DatePicker date={d} onDateChange={setD} placeholder=… />`.
- **metric-delta:** renders a delta % with up/down color — use for `deltaPct` (check its props in the file).

## Foundation contracts (Wave 0 builds these — Wave 1 consumes EXACTLY this API)
1. **Route store** `routes/(app)/dashboard/-stores/useDashboardStore.ts` (zustand):
   `{ discountAdditionalCosts: boolean; setDiscountAdditionalCosts(v:boolean): void; toggleDiscountAdditionalCosts(): void }`
   (default false). Read with selectors: `useDashboardStore(s => s.discountAdditionalCosts)`.
2. **Gauge** `@/components/ui/gauge` — a 180° semicircle progress arc.
   Props: `{ value: number /* 0..1 */, className?, trackClassName?, indicatorClassName?, children?: ReactNode }`.
   Renders an SVG semicircle (track + colored indicator filling `value` of the half-circle); `children` is centered
   content (the big `%`). Green indicator when value>=1. Include a `Gauge.stories.tsx`.
3. **MoneyInput** `@/components/ui/money-input` — currency selector + masked amount, controlled.
   Props: `{ amountCents: number; onAmountCentsChange(c:number): void; currency: string; onCurrencyChange(c:string): void; currencies?: string[]; placeholder? }`.
   Layout: `InputGroup` with a `Select` (currency, with flag if easy) + masked number input ("0,00"). Use a currency
   mask added to `src/lib/masks.ts` via `bun cli mask` (or Maskito number options inline). Emits integer cents. Story it.
4. **i18n keys:** add a `dashboard` namespace block to `pt.json` + `en.json` covering all the labels below.

## SDK hooks + KEYED output shapes (all exist + regenerated)
All hooks from `@bk-dash/client-typescript/typescript`. Read hooks take query params object; mutations: `const m = useX(); await m.mutateAsync({ data }, { onSuccess, onSettled })`. Metric = `{ value: number, deltaPct: number|null }`. Tally = `{ count: Metric, value: Metric }`.

- **useGetPixelFunnel** → `{ hasPixel, base: Metric, steps: { PAGE_VIEWED: Metric, PRODUCT_VIEWED, PRODUCT_ADDED_TO_CART, PRODUCT_REMOVED_FROM_CART, CART_VIEWED, CHECKOUT_STARTED, CHECKOUT_CONTACT_INFO_SUBMITTED, CHECKOUT_COMPLETED }, conversionRate: Metric, carts: Tally }`. Query params: `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate, productIds? }` (default last 30 days).
- **useGetDashboard** → discriminated by `kind` (`SINGLE_GLOBAL`|`SINGLE_NATIONAL`|`MULTI_GLOBAL`|`MULTI_NATIONAL`). Use SINGLE (kind starts `SINGLE_`): `{ kind, tenancyScope, dashboardMode, store, stat, details }`. `details = { orders, fees, ads, productCost, chargeback: { byStatus:{total:Metric,segments}, fees:Metric }, refund: Metric, taxes: { ads:Metric, others:Metric }, operational: { total: Metric, items: [...] } }`. Query params `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate, productIds? }`.
- **useListQuickProductRanking** → `{ totalProducts: number, items: { productId, name, imageUrl: string|null, sales: Tally }[] }` (top 10). `sales.value` = revenue (money), `sales.count` = units sold.
- **useGetGoal** → `{ goal: { id, storeId, type:'REVENUE'|'PROFIT', targetAmount:{ amountCents, currency }, from, to } | null }`. Query `{}` (session store).
- **useGetGoalProgress** → `{ byType: { REVENUE?: { target:number, achieved:number, stores:[{storeId,storeName,target,achieved}] }, PROFIT?: {...} } }`. Query `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate }`.
- Mutations: **useCreateGoal**(`createGoalMutationRequestSchema`: `{ type, currency, targetAmount:{amountCents,currency}, from, to }` — check exact), **useUpdateGoal**(`{ goalId, data }`), **useCreateOperationalCost**(`createOperationalCostMutationRequestSchema`: `{ flow:'CREDIT'|'DEBIT', amount/currency, name, frequency, startDate, endDate?, category? }` — check exact), **useUpsertWarranty**(`upsertWarrantyMutationRequestSchema`: `{ percentage, startDate, periodDays }` — check exact). Invalidate the relevant query key on success; toast via `sonner`.

> Use the generated `*MutationRequestSchema` directly as TanStack Form `validators.onChange`. Inspect the exact request
> field names in the generated `…Schema.ts`/types before wiring (names above are best-effort).

## Form pattern (TanStack Form + SDK schema)
`useForm({ defaultValues, validators:{ onChange: <op>MutationRequestSchema }, onSubmit: async f => { const r = schema.safeParse(f.value); if(!r.success) return; await mutation.mutateAsync({ data: r.data }, { onSuccess, onSettled }) } })`. Submit gated via `form.Subscribe`. Drawers use `<Sheet>`; close on success.

## Storybook
CSF3 (`Meta`/`StoryObj`), `@storybook/react-vite`. NO QueryClient/MSW in preview → **only story leaf/prop-driven
components** (pass mock data as args) + skeleton/empty states. Do NOT story hook-owning Sections. Place stories at
`<Name>/stories/<Name>.stories.tsx` (or `<Name>/<Name>.stories.tsx`). Mirror `src/components/StatCard/StatCard.stories.tsx`.

---

# COMPONENTS (each agent: build ONE cluster under `-components/`, with leaf stories; DO NOT edit the route `index.tsx`)

## A) FunnelSection  (hook: useGetPixelFunnel)
Card spanning a row. 5 step columns + a right rail with 2 highlight cards.
- **FunnelStep** (leaf ×5): label (Page View / View Content / Add to Cart / Initiate Checkout / Purchase →
  PAGE_VIEWED, PRODUCT_VIEWED, PRODUCT_ADDED_TO_CART, CHECKOUT_STARTED, CHECKOUT_COMPLETED), big `%` (step.value/base.value),
  small "{count} de {base}" with a users icon, and a purple area/bar whose height ∝ the fraction (simple SVG/CSS, sloping
  down to the next step is decorative — a filled trapezoid is fine). Props: `{ label, pct, count, base }`. Story it.
- **FunnelHighlightCard** (leaf ×2): "Taxa de Conversão" (value=conversionRate %, delta) and "Carrinhos"
  (value=carts.value money, delta) — each: icon + label + info hint + big value + metric-delta. Props-driven. Story it.
- Empty state: `hasPixel === false` → show a "instalar Pixel" CTA instead of steps.

## B) AdditionalCostsSection  (hook: useGetDashboard, store: useDashboardStore)  + 2 drawers
Card. Header: money icon badge + "Custos Adicionais" + big total (sum of the rows below, derived). A **Checkbox**
"Descontar Custos Adicionais" bound to `useDashboardStore` (`discountAdditionalCosts` / `toggleDiscountAdditionalCosts`).
Separator. Rows (label + value in RED money): Chargeback (`details.chargeback.byStatus.total.value`), Reembolso
(`details.refund.value`), Impostos (`details.taxes.ads.value + details.taxes.others.value`), Operacional
(`details.operational.total.value`), Garantia (warranty — NO read hook yet → show "Sem Garantia" in green).
- Impostos / Operacional / Garantia rows each have a small purple **+** button.
  - Operacional **+** → opens **OperationalCostDrawer** (Sheet) — form via **useCreateOperationalCost** +
    `createOperationalCostMutationRequestSchema`. Fields: Saída/Entrada (flow checkboxes, exactly one), Valor
    (**MoneyInput**), Descrição (input), Frequência (Select), Data de Início (DatePicker), Categoria (Select). Title
    "Adicionar Custo Operacional".
  - Garantia **+** → opens **WarrantyDrawer** (Sheet) — form via **useUpsertWarranty** + its schema. Fields:
    Porcentagem de Garantia (% input), Data de Início (DatePicker), Período (Select e.g. "30 dias"). Submit "Editar Garantia".
  - Impostos **+** → link to `/app/settings/taxesAndFees` (no drawer provided) — use a Link/navigate; flag as follow-up.
- Story the leaf row (`AdditionalCostRow` with props label/value/tone/onAdd?) + the drawers' form bodies if practical.

## C) GoalSection  (hooks: useGetGoal + useGetGoalProgress)  + Goal drawer
Card. Header "Meta de Faturamento" + an edit **pencil** button (top-right) → opens **GoalDrawer**. Body: **Gauge**
(value = achieved/target capped 0..1) with big `%` centered; below: "{achievedMoney} de {targetMoney}" (achieved green,
target muted). Pick the active goal from `useGetGoal().goal`; type=goal.type → read `useGetGoalProgress().byType[goal.type]`
for `{ target, achieved }`. Empty: goal === null → "Nenhuma meta cadastrada" + a "criar meta" affordance opening the drawer.
- **GoalDrawer** (Sheet): form via **useCreateGoal** (or **useUpdateGoal** when editing an existing goal). Title
  "Meta de Faturamento". Fields: Meta (**MoneyInput**), Data de Início da Meta (DatePicker), Data de Fim da Meta
  (DatePicker), "Selecione o tipo da sua meta" → Faturamento/Lucro (REVENUE/PROFIT, two checkboxes/radio, exactly one).
  Submit "Editar Meta"/"Criar Meta". Prefill from the current goal when editing.
- Story the gauge-display leaf with mock `{ pct, achieved, target, currency }`.

## D) RankingSection  (hook: useListQuickProductRanking)
Card. Header: package icon badge + "Ranking" + big `{totalProducts}` + a "Ver Tudo" button → Link `/app/products`.
Separator. Scrollable list (max ~3.5 rows visible) of **RankingProductRow** (leaf ×N, top 10): square product image
(`imageUrl` or placeholder), name (truncate), `{salesValueMoney}` (sales.value.value), and "{salesCount} Vendido(s)"
(sales.count.value) right-aligned. Props-driven leaf. Story it (with image + placeholder variants).

--- name: component description: Create a React component that owns its own data. Use when building any route-specific UI — lists, panels, cards, dialogs, filters. Components fetch their own data via React Query, read params from routeApi.useSearch() or Zustand stores, and handle mutations internally. --- > **BEFORE IMPLEMENTING**: Open [`registry.yaml`](./registry.yaml) and read: > 1. **`patterns`** — all `when: always` are mandatory; evaluate each conditional (`when: `) before coding > 2. **`bad_practices`** — keep these violations in mind throughout implementation # Create React Component Creates a React component that owns its data and actions. ## Core Mental Model Every component is responsible for the data it renders: | Need | Source | How | |------|--------|-----| | URL state (filters, pagination, selected ID) | Route search params | `routeApi.useSearch()` | | Update URL state | Route navigate | `routeApi.useNavigate()` | | Client state (UI toggles, selections, shared IDs) | Zustand store | `useStore()` | | Server data | React Query | `useQuery()` / SDK hooks directly | | Mutations | React Query | `useMutation()` / SDK hooks directly | **No prop drilling of data, search params, or callbacks.** React Query deduplicates — if multiple components call the same query, only one request fires. ## When to Use This Skill - Building any route-specific UI component (list, panel, card, dialog, filter bar) - Adding inline skeleton loading states - Extracting repeated JSX into a local or nested component ## When NOT to Use This Skill - Building reusable design system components (use `/primitive` skill) - Creating a new page with routing (use `/route` skill) - Creating forms with validation (use `/form` skill) - Adding state management stores (use `/store` skill) > **Modal/Dialog with data input**: Use the `/form` skill for the form inside. This skill handles the dialog shell and layout. ## Prerequisites - **Design System Check**: Check if `SYSTEM.md` exists at the project root. If not, use `/design-system` first. - Check available primitives in `@/components/ui/` before creating new components - SDK must be generated (use `/sdk` first) for types and enums ## Key Principles 1. **Component Owns Data**: Each component fetches what it needs via React Query. No data props from parent. 2. **Leaf Components Receive Props**: Components rendered N times in a `.map()` (cards, rows, badges) receive a single item as a prop. They don't re-query — the parent owns the list query and passes each item down. 3. **Two Param Sources**: URL state via `routeApi.useSearch()`, client state via `useStore()`. 4. **Open/Closed Principle**: Never hardcode options in JSX. Derive from SDK Enums + labels maps. 5. **DRY Local**: Repeated JSX in the same file → Extract to local component. 6. **Primitive First**: Always check `@/components/ui/` for existing primitives before creating raw HTML. 7. **ARIA-Navigable**: Every interactive element without visible text must have an `aria-label`. Form fields need `id={field.name}` to connect with ``. This enables accessibility and E2E testing. ### Owns Query vs Receives Props — Decision Rule **"Am I rendered N times in a `.map()`?"** - **No** → component owns its query (reads IDs from store/search params, fetches data) - **Yes** → component receives a single item as a prop (parent maps the list) ``` ProductList (owns query — rendered once) └── ProductCard ({ product } — rendered N times in .map()) ChatSidebar (owns query — rendered once) └── ChatListItem ({ item } — rendered N times in .map()) StatsGrid (owns query — rendered once) └── StatCard ({ stat } — rendered N times in .map()) PatientInfoPanel (owns query — rendered once, not repeated) ``` Leaf components (cards, rows, badges) are reusable and testable because they only depend on their props. They CAN own mutations (e.g., a delete button on a card) but they should NOT re-fetch the item they already received. ## Folder Structure All components live in `-components/`. Dependencies are colocated under their parent: ``` route/ ├── route.tsx # Minimal — layout, conditional rendering ├── -stores/ # Zustand stores for shared state ├── -hooks/ # Shared hooks (SSE, realtime) └── -components/ ├── ProductList/ # Fetches products, renders list │ ├── index.tsx │ ├── ProductCard/ # Receives single item as prop │ │ └── index.tsx │ └── stories/ ├── FilterBar/ # Reads/writes search params directly │ └── index.tsx └── EmptyState/ └── index.tsx ``` ### Section Components (naming convention only) `Section` is a **naming convention** for container components that own data and orchestrate a region of the screen — e.g., `PatientListSection`, `OverviewSection`. It is **not** a separate citizen type with its own rules. - **Same rules as any other component** — a Section **owns its own query**, reads search params via `routeApi.useSearch()`, reads Zustand stores, dispatches mutations. **No `data` prop from the route.** Routes never fetch data to pass down. - **Renders inline skeleton when its own `data` is undefined** — the static UI (headers, buttons, search inputs) stays visible while the data-dependent area shows a ``. Routes never gate on `isLoading`. - **Colocated in `-components/`** — sections live in the route's `-components/` folder, not a separate `-sections/` folder. The `Section` suffix is purely a name hint for "container that orchestrates this region". ```typescript // CORRECT — section owns its query, no data prop from route import { useListPatients } from '@bk-dash/client-typescript/typescript' const routeApi = getRouteApi('/(app)/patients/') export function PatientListSection() { const { page, search } = routeApi.useSearch() const { data } = useListPatients({ params: { page, search } }) return (
{/* Static UI always visible */} {/* Data-dependent area handles its own skeleton */} {data ? : }
) } // WRONG — section receiving data as prop (old pattern, do not use) export function PatientListSection({ data }: { data: PatientListResponse | undefined }) { … } ``` ## Data Access Pattern ### Route API for search params Every component that needs search params uses `getRouteApi()`: ```typescript import { getRouteApi } from '@tanstack/react-router' const routeApi = getRouteApi('/(app)/products/') export function ProductList() { const { page, search } = routeApi.useSearch() const navigate = routeApi.useNavigate() const { data } = useListProducts({ params: { page, search } }) const handlePageChange = (page: number) => navigate({ search: prev => ({ ...prev, page }) }) } ``` ### Store for shared IDs and UI state ```typescript export function ChatPanel() { const channelId = useChatStore(s => s.channelId) const { data } = useGetMessages({ params: { channelId } }) } ``` ### Parent fetches list, leaf receives item The only case where props are the right choice: a parent renders a list and passes each item to a leaf component. The leaf doesn't re-fetch — it renders one item. ```typescript // Parent owns the list query export function ProductList() { const { data } = useListProducts(...) return data?.items.map(p => ) } // Leaf renders one item — no query needed function ProductCard({ product }: { product: ProductItem }) { return {product.name} } ``` ## Process ### Step 1: Check Existing Primitives **ALWAYS** check `@/components/ui/` first for existing primitives: ```typescript import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button' import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card' import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input' import { Select } from '@/components/ui/select' import { Dialog } from '@/components/ui/dialog' import { Table } from '@/components/ui/table' import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton' ``` **BLOCKING PREREQUISITE**: Run `ls packages/app/react/src/components/ui/` BEFORE creating any component. #### HTML → Primitive Mapping (mandatory) [bp-11] | HTML Element | Primitive | Import | |-------------|-----------|--------| | `` | Input | `@/components/ui/input` | | `

# Dashboard frontend build — shared brief

App: `packages/app/react` (TanStack Start + Vite). Route: `src/routes/(app)/dashboard/`. Build components under
`routes/(app)/dashboard/-components/<Name>/`. Run shells with `export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"`.

## Conventions (HARD RULES)
- **Data ownership:** every Section/Component fetches its OWN data via SDK hooks. NO `data` prop from route/parent.
  Leaves rendered in a `.map()` receive the single item by prop and MUST NOT re-fetch. Search params via
  `getRouteApi('/(app)/dashboard/').useSearch()` (never props). Shared client state via the zustand store (never props).
- **Section** = container that owns a query + orchestrates a region; suffix `Section`; lives in `-components/`.
- **Skeleton inline:** static UI (headers/buttons) always visible; only the data area swaps to `<Skeleton/>`:
  `{data ? <Real/> : <Skeleton/>}`. Import `Skeleton` from `@/components/ui/skeleton`.
- **SDK import specifier:** `@bk-dash/client-typescript/typescript` (hooks, schemas `*MutationRequestSchema`, query keys
  `*QueryKey`, types). React Query dedupes — multiple components calling the same hook = one request.
- **i18n:** all visible text via `react-i18next` `useTranslation()` with keys under `dashboard.*`
  (`src/locales/pt.json` + `en.json`, typed by `@types/i18next.d.ts`). pt is the source language.
- **Verify:** `cd packages/app/react && bun x tsc --noEmit` + `bun run lint`. Stories: `bun run storybook:build`.

## Primitives (`@/components/ui/*`) — exist
`button, card, sheet (DRAWER), checkbox, switch, select, date-picker, input, input-group, label, field, skeleton,
separator, tooltip, badge, avatar, progress, dropdown-menu, popover, spinner, sonner` (+ `metric-delta`, `info-hint`,
`gradient-icon`, `gradient-icon-badge`).
- **Sheet/Drawer:** `import { Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetFooter, SheetClose } from '@/components/ui/sheet'`. `<SheetContent side="right">`. Trigger: `<SheetTrigger render={<Button/>} />`.
- **Checkbox:** `<Checkbox checked={v} onCheckedChange={setV} />` + `<Label htmlFor>` inside `<Field orientation="horizontal">`.
- **Select:** `Select/SelectTrigger/SelectValue/SelectContent/SelectItem` (value/onValueChange).
- **DatePicker:** `<DatePicker date={d} onDateChange={setD} placeholder=… />`.
- **metric-delta:** renders a delta % with up/down color — use for `deltaPct` (check its props in the file).

## Foundation contracts (Wave 0 builds these — Wave 1 consumes EXACTLY this API)
1. **Route store** `routes/(app)/dashboard/-stores/useDashboardStore.ts` (zustand):
   `{ discountAdditionalCosts: boolean; setDiscountAdditionalCosts(v:boolean): void; toggleDiscountAdditionalCosts(): void }`
   (default false). Read with selectors: `useDashboardStore(s => s.discountAdditionalCosts)`.
2. **Gauge** `@/components/ui/gauge` — a 180° semicircle progress arc.
   Props: `{ value: number /* 0..1 */, className?, trackClassName?, indicatorClassName?, children?: ReactNode }`.
   Renders an SVG semicircle (track + colored indicator filling `value` of the half-circle); `children` is centered
   content (the big `%`). Green indicator when value>=1. Include a `Gauge.stories.tsx`.
3. **MoneyInput** `@/components/ui/money-input` — currency selector + masked amount, controlled.
   Props: `{ amountCents: number; onAmountCentsChange(c:number): void; currency: string; onCurrencyChange(c:string): void; currencies?: string[]; placeholder? }`.
   Layout: `InputGroup` with a `Select` (currency, with flag if easy) + masked number input ("0,00"). Use a currency
   mask added to `src/lib/masks.ts` via `bun cli mask` (or Maskito number options inline). Emits integer cents. Story it.
4. **i18n keys:** add a `dashboard` namespace block to `pt.json` + `en.json` covering all the labels below.

## SDK hooks + KEYED output shapes (all exist + regenerated)
All hooks from `@bk-dash/client-typescript/typescript`. Read hooks take query params object; mutations: `const m = useX(); await m.mutateAsync({ data }, { onSuccess, onSettled })`. Metric = `{ value: number, deltaPct: number|null }`. Tally = `{ count: Metric, value: Metric }`.

- **useGetPixelFunnel** → `{ hasPixel, base: Metric, steps: { PAGE_VIEWED: Metric, PRODUCT_VIEWED, PRODUCT_ADDED_TO_CART, PRODUCT_REMOVED_FROM_CART, CART_VIEWED, CHECKOUT_STARTED, CHECKOUT_CONTACT_INFO_SUBMITTED, CHECKOUT_COMPLETED }, conversionRate: Metric, carts: Tally }`. Query params: `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate, productIds? }` (default last 30 days).
- **useGetDashboard** → discriminated by `kind` (`SINGLE_GLOBAL`|`SINGLE_NATIONAL`|`MULTI_GLOBAL`|`MULTI_NATIONAL`). Use SINGLE (kind starts `SINGLE_`): `{ kind, tenancyScope, dashboardMode, store, stat, details }`. `details = { orders, fees, ads, productCost, chargeback: { byStatus:{total:Metric,segments}, fees:Metric }, refund: Metric, taxes: { ads:Metric, others:Metric }, operational: { total: Metric, items: [...] } }`. Query params `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate, productIds? }`.
- **useListQuickProductRanking** → `{ totalProducts: number, items: { productId, name, imageUrl: string|null, sales: Tally }[] }` (top 10). `sales.value` = revenue (money), `sales.count` = units sold.
- **useGetGoal** → `{ goal: { id, storeId, type:'REVENUE'|'PROFIT', targetAmount:{ amountCents, currency }, from, to } | null }`. Query `{}` (session store).
- **useGetGoalProgress** → `{ byType: { REVENUE?: { target:number, achieved:number, stores:[{storeId,storeName,target,achieved}] }, PROFIT?: {...} } }`. Query `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate }`.
- Mutations: **useCreateGoal**(`createGoalMutationRequestSchema`: `{ type, currency, targetAmount:{amountCents,currency}, from, to }` — check exact), **useUpdateGoal**(`{ goalId, data }`), **useCreateOperationalCost**(`createOperationalCostMutationRequestSchema`: `{ flow:'CREDIT'|'DEBIT', amount/currency, name, frequency, startDate, endDate?, category? }` — check exact), **useUpsertWarranty**(`upsertWarrantyMutationRequestSchema`: `{ percentage, startDate, periodDays }` — check exact). Invalidate the relevant query key on success; toast via `sonner`.

> Use the generated `*MutationRequestSchema` directly as TanStack Form `validators.onChange`. Inspect the exact request
> field names in the generated `…Schema.ts`/types before wiring (names above are best-effort).

## Form pattern (TanStack Form + SDK schema)
`useForm({ defaultValues, validators:{ onChange: <op>MutationRequestSchema }, onSubmit: async f => { const r = schema.safeParse(f.value); if(!r.success) return; await mutation.mutateAsync({ data: r.data }, { onSuccess, onSettled }) } })`. Submit gated via `form.Subscribe`. Drawers use `<Sheet>`; close on success.

## Storybook
CSF3 (`Meta`/`StoryObj`), `@storybook/react-vite`. NO QueryClient/MSW in preview → **only story leaf/prop-driven
components** (pass mock data as args) + skeleton/empty states. Do NOT story hook-owning Sections. Place stories at
`<Name>/stories/<Name>.stories.tsx` (or `<Name>/<Name>.stories.tsx`). Mirror `src/components/StatCard/StatCard.stories.tsx`.

---

# COMPONENTS (each agent: build ONE cluster under `-components/`, with leaf stories; DO NOT edit the route `index.tsx`)

## A) FunnelSection  (hook: useGetPixelFunnel)
Card spanning a row. 5 step columns + a right rail with 2 highlight cards.
- **FunnelStep** (leaf ×5): label (Page View / View Content / Add to Cart / Initiate Checkout / Purchase →
  PAGE_VIEWED, PRODUCT_VIEWED, PRODUCT_ADDED_TO_CART, CHECKOUT_STARTED, CHECKOUT_COMPLETED), big `%` (step.value/base.value),
  small "{count} de {base}" with a users icon, and a purple area/bar whose height ∝ the fraction (simple SVG/CSS, sloping
  down to the next step is decorative — a filled trapezoid is fine). Props: `{ label, pct, count, base }`. Story it.
- **FunnelHighlightCard** (leaf ×2): "Taxa de Conversão" (value=conversionRate %, delta) and "Carrinhos"
  (value=carts.value money, delta) — each: icon + label + info hint + big value + metric-delta. Props-driven. Story it.
- Empty state: `hasPixel === false` → show a "instalar Pixel" CTA instead of steps.

## B) AdditionalCostsSection  (hook: useGetDashboard, store: useDashboardStore)  + 2 drawers
Card. Header: money icon badge + "Custos Adicionais" + big total (sum of the rows below, derived). A **Checkbox**
"Descontar Custos Adicionais" bound to `useDashboardStore` (`discountAdditionalCosts` / `toggleDiscountAdditionalCosts`).
Separator. Rows (label + value in RED money): Chargeback (`details.chargeback.byStatus.total.value`), Reembolso
(`details.refund.value`), Impostos (`details.taxes.ads.value + details.taxes.others.value`), Operacional
(`details.operational.total.value`), Garantia (warranty — NO read hook yet → show "Sem Garantia" in green).
- Impostos / Operacional / Garantia rows each have a small purple **+** button.
  - Operacional **+** → opens **OperationalCostDrawer** (Sheet) — form via **useCreateOperationalCost** +
    `createOperationalCostMutationRequestSchema`. Fields: Saída/Entrada (flow checkboxes, exactly one), Valor
    (**MoneyInput**), Descrição (input), Frequência (Select), Data de Início (DatePicker), Categoria (Select). Title
    "Adicionar Custo Operacional".
  - Garantia **+** → opens **WarrantyDrawer** (Sheet) — form via **useUpsertWarranty** + its schema. Fields:
    Porcentagem de Garantia (% input), Data de Início (DatePicker), Período (Select e.g. "30 dias"). Submit "Editar Garantia".
  - Impostos **+** → link to `/app/settings/taxesAndFees` (no drawer provided) — use a Link/navigate; flag as follow-up.
- Story the leaf row (`AdditionalCostRow` with props label/value/tone/onAdd?) + the drawers' form bodies if practical.

## C) GoalSection  (hooks: useGetGoal + useGetGoalProgress)  + Goal drawer
Card. Header "Meta de Faturamento" + an edit **pencil** button (top-right) → opens **GoalDrawer**. Body: **Gauge**
(value = achieved/target capped 0..1) with big `%` centered; below: "{achievedMoney} de {targetMoney}" (achieved green,
target muted). Pick the active goal from `useGetGoal().goal`; type=goal.type → read `useGetGoalProgress().byType[goal.type]`
for `{ target, achieved }`. Empty: goal === null → "Nenhuma meta cadastrada" + a "criar meta" affordance opening the drawer.
- **GoalDrawer** (Sheet): form via **useCreateGoal** (or **useUpdateGoal** when editing an existing goal). Title
  "Meta de Faturamento". Fields: Meta (**MoneyInput**), Data de Início da Meta (DatePicker), Data de Fim da Meta
  (DatePicker), "Selecione o tipo da sua meta" → Faturamento/Lucro (REVENUE/PROFIT, two checkboxes/radio, exactly one).
  Submit "Editar Meta"/"Criar Meta". Prefill from the current goal when editing.
- Story the gauge-display leaf with mock `{ pct, achieved, target, currency }`.

## D) RankingSection  (hook: useListQuickProductRanking)
Card. Header: package icon badge + "Ranking" + big `{totalProducts}` + a "Ver Tudo" button → Link `/app/products`.
Separator. Scrollable list (max ~3.5 rows visible) of **RankingProductRow** (leaf ×N, top 10): square product image
(`imageUrl` or placeholder), name (truncate), `{salesValueMoney}` (sales.value.value), and "{salesCount} Vendido(s)"
(sales.count.value) right-aligned. Props-driven leaf. Story it (with image + placeholder variants).

# Dashboard frontend build — shared brief

App: `packages/app/react` (TanStack Start + Vite). Route: `src/routes/(app)/dashboard/`. Build components under
`routes/(app)/dashboard/-components/<Name>/`. Run shells with `export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"`.

## Conventions (HARD RULES)
- **Data ownership:** every Section/Component fetches its OWN data via SDK hooks. NO `data` prop from route/parent.
  Leaves rendered in a `.map()` receive the single item by prop and MUST NOT re-fetch. Search params via
  `getRouteApi('/(app)/dashboard/').useSearch()` (never props). Shared client state via the zustand store (never props).
- **Section** = container that owns a query + orchestrates a region; suffix `Section`; lives in `-components/`.
- **Skeleton inline:** static UI (headers/buttons) always visible; only the data area swaps to `<Skeleton/>`:
  `{data ? <Real/> : <Skeleton/>}`. Import `Skeleton` from `@/components/ui/skeleton`.
- **SDK import specifier:** `@bk-dash/client-typescript/typescript` (hooks, schemas `*MutationRequestSchema`, query keys
  `*QueryKey`, types). React Query dedupes — multiple components calling the same hook = one request.
- **i18n:** all visible text via `react-i18next` `useTranslation()` with keys under `dashboard.*`
  (`src/locales/pt.json` + `en.json`, typed by `@types/i18next.d.ts`). pt is the source language.
- **Verify:** `cd packages/app/react && bun x tsc --noEmit` + `bun run lint`. Stories: `bun run storybook:build`.

## Primitives (`@/components/ui/*`) — exist
`button, card, sheet (DRAWER), checkbox, switch, select, date-picker, input, input-group, label, field, skeleton,
separator, tooltip, badge, avatar, progress, dropdown-menu, popover, spinner, sonner` (+ `metric-delta`, `info-hint`,
`gradient-icon`, `gradient-icon-badge`).
- **Sheet/Drawer:** `import { Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetFooter, SheetClose } from '@/components/ui/sheet'`. `<SheetContent side="right">`. Trigger: `<SheetTrigger render={<Button/>} />`.
- **Checkbox:** `<Checkbox checked={v} onCheckedChange={setV} />` + `<Label htmlFor>` inside `<Field orientation="horizontal">`.
- **Select:** `Select/SelectTrigger/SelectValue/SelectContent/SelectItem` (value/onValueChange).
- **DatePicker:** `<DatePicker date={d} onDateChange={setD} placeholder=… />`.
- **metric-delta:** renders a delta % with up/down color — use for `deltaPct` (check its props in the file).

## Foundation contracts (Wave 0 builds these — Wave 1 consumes EXACTLY this API)
1. **Route store** `routes/(app)/dashboard/-stores/useDashboardStore.ts` (zustand):
   `{ discountAdditionalCosts: boolean; setDiscountAdditionalCosts(v:boolean): void; toggleDiscountAdditionalCosts(): void }`
   (default false). Read with selectors: `useDashboardStore(s => s.discountAdditionalCosts)`.
2. **Gauge** `@/components/ui/gauge` — a 180° semicircle progress arc.
   Props: `{ value: number /* 0..1 */, className?, trackClassName?, indicatorClassName?, children?: ReactNode }`.
   Renders an SVG semicircle (track + colored indicator filling `value` of the half-circle); `children` is centered
   content (the big `%`). Green indicator when value>=1. Include a `Gauge.stories.tsx`.
3. **MoneyInput** `@/components/ui/money-input` — currency selector + masked amount, controlled.
   Props: `{ amountCents: number; onAmountCentsChange(c:number): void; currency: string; onCurrencyChange(c:string): void; currencies?: string[]; placeholder? }`.
   Layout: `InputGroup` with a `Select` (currency, with flag if easy) + masked number input ("0,00"). Use a currency
   mask added to `src/lib/masks.ts` via `bun cli mask` (or Maskito number options inline). Emits integer cents. Story it.
4. **i18n keys:** add a `dashboard` namespace block to `pt.json` + `en.json` covering all the labels below.

## SDK hooks + KEYED output shapes (all exist + regenerated)
All hooks from `@bk-dash/client-typescript/typescript`. Read hooks take query params object; mutations: `const m = useX(); await m.mutateAsync({ data }, { onSuccess, onSettled })`. Metric = `{ value: number, deltaPct: number|null }`. Tally = `{ count: Metric, value: Metric }`.

- **useGetPixelFunnel** → `{ hasPixel, base: Metric, steps: { PAGE_VIEWED: Metric, PRODUCT_VIEWED, PRODUCT_ADDED_TO_CART, PRODUCT_REMOVED_FROM_CART, CART_VIEWED, CHECKOUT_STARTED, CHECKOUT_CONTACT_INFO_SUBMITTED, CHECKOUT_COMPLETED }, conversionRate: Metric, carts: Tally }`. Query params: `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate, productIds? }` (default last 30 days).
- **useGetDashboard** → discriminated by `kind` (`SINGLE_GLOBAL`|`SINGLE_NATIONAL`|`MULTI_GLOBAL`|`MULTI_NATIONAL`). Use SINGLE (kind starts `SINGLE_`): `{ kind, tenancyScope, dashboardMode, store, stat, details }`. `details = { orders, fees, ads, productCost, chargeback: { byStatus:{total:Metric,segments}, fees:Metric }, refund: Metric, taxes: { ads:Metric, others:Metric }, operational: { total: Metric, items: [...] } }`. Query params `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate, productIds? }`.
- **useListQuickProductRanking** → `{ totalProducts: number, items: { productId, name, imageUrl: string|null, sales: Tally }[] }` (top 10). `sales.value` = revenue (money), `sales.count` = units sold.
- **useGetGoal** → `{ goal: { id, storeId, type:'REVENUE'|'PROFIT', targetAmount:{ amountCents, currency }, from, to } | null }`. Query `{}` (session store).
- **useGetGoalProgress** → `{ byType: { REVENUE?: { target:number, achieved:number, stores:[{storeId,storeName,target,achieved}] }, PROFIT?: {...} } }`. Query `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate }`.
- Mutations: **useCreateGoal**(`createGoalMutationRequestSchema`: `{ type, currency, targetAmount:{amountCents,currency}, from, to }` — check exact), **useUpdateGoal**(`{ goalId, data }`), **useCreateOperationalCost**(`createOperationalCostMutationRequestSchema`: `{ flow:'CREDIT'|'DEBIT', amount/currency, name, frequency, startDate, endDate?, category? }` — check exact), **useUpsertWarranty**(`upsertWarrantyMutationRequestSchema`: `{ percentage, startDate, periodDays }` — check exact). Invalidate the relevant query key on success; toast via `sonner`.

> Use the generated `*MutationRequestSchema` directly as TanStack Form `validators.onChange`. Inspect the exact request
> field names in the generated `…Schema.ts`/types before wiring (names above are best-effort).

## Form pattern (TanStack Form + SDK schema)
`useForm({ defaultValues, validators:{ onChange: <op>MutationRequestSchema }, onSubmit: async f => { const r = schema.safeParse(f.value); if(!r.success) return; await mutation.mutateAsync({ data: r.data }, { onSuccess, onSettled }) } })`. Submit gated via `form.Subscribe`. Drawers use `<Sheet>`; close on success.

## Storybook
CSF3 (`Meta`/`StoryObj`), `@storybook/react-vite`. NO QueryClient/MSW in preview → **only story leaf/prop-driven
components** (pass mock data as args) + skeleton/empty states. Do NOT story hook-owning Sections. Place stories at
`<Name>/stories/<Name>.stories.tsx` (or `<Name>/<Name>.stories.tsx`). Mirror `src/components/StatCard/StatCard.stories.tsx`.

# Dashboard frontend build — shared brief

App: `packages/app/react` (TanStack Start + Vite). Route: `src/routes/(app)/dashboard/`. Build components under
`routes/(app)/dashboard/-components/<Name>/`. Run shells with `export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"`.

## Conventions (HARD RULES)
- **Data ownership:** every Section/Component fetches its OWN data via SDK hooks. NO `data` prop from route/parent.
  Leaves rendered in a `.map()` receive the single item by prop and MUST NOT re-fetch. Search params via
  `getRouteApi('/(app)/dashboard/').useSearch()` (never props). Shared client state via the zustand store (never props).
- **Section** = container that owns a query + orchestrates a region; suffix `Section`; lives in `-components/`.
- **Skeleton inline:** static UI (headers/buttons) always visible; only the data area swaps to `<Skeleton/>`:
  `{data ? <Real/> : <Skeleton/>}`. Import `Skeleton` from `@/components/ui/skeleton`.
- **SDK import specifier:** `@bk-dash/client-typescript/typescript` (hooks, schemas `*MutationRequestSchema`, query keys
  `*QueryKey`, types). React Query dedupes — multiple components calling the same hook = one request.
- **i18n:** all visible text via `react-i18next` `useTranslation()` with keys under `dashboard.*`
  (`src/locales/pt.json` + `en.json`, typed by `@types/i18next.d.ts`). pt is the source language.
- **Verify:** `cd packages/app/react && bun x tsc --noEmit` + `bun run lint`. Stories: `bun run storybook:build`.

## Primitives (`@/components/ui/*`) — exist
`button, card, sheet (DRAWER), checkbox, switch, select, date-picker, input, input-group, label, field, skeleton,
separator, tooltip, badge, avatar, progress, dropdown-menu, popover, spinner, sonner` (+ `metric-delta`, `info-hint`,
`gradient-icon`, `gradient-icon-badge`).
- **Sheet/Drawer:** `import { Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetFooter, SheetClose } from '@/components/ui/sheet'`. `<SheetContent side="right">`. Trigger: `<SheetTrigger render={<Button/>} />`.
- **Checkbox:** `<Checkbox checked={v} onCheckedChange={setV} />` + `<Label htmlFor>` inside `<Field orientation="horizontal">`.
- **Select:** `Select/SelectTrigger/SelectValue/SelectContent/SelectItem` (value/onValueChange).
- **DatePicker:** `<DatePicker date={d} onDateChange={setD} placeholder=… />`.
- **metric-delta:** renders a delta % with up/down color — use for `deltaPct` (check its props in the file).

## Foundation contracts (Wave 0 builds these — Wave 1 consumes EXACTLY this API)
1. **Route store** `routes/(app)/dashboard/-stores/useDashboardStore.ts` (zustand):
   `{ discountAdditionalCosts: boolean; setDiscountAdditionalCosts(v:boolean): void; toggleDiscountAdditionalCosts(): void }`
   (default false). Read with selectors: `useDashboardStore(s => s.discountAdditionalCosts)`.
2. **Gauge** `@/components/ui/gauge` — a 180° semicircle progress arc.
   Props: `{ value: number /* 0..1 */, className?, trackClassName?, indicatorClassName?, children?: ReactNode }`.
   Renders an SVG semicircle (track + colored indicator filling `value` of the half-circle); `children` is centered
   content (the big `%`). Green indicator when value>=1. Include a `Gauge.stories.tsx`.
3. **MoneyInput** `@/components/ui/money-input` — currency selector + masked amount, controlled.
   Props: `{ amountCents: number; onAmountCentsChange(c:number): void; currency: string; onCurrencyChange(c:string): void; currencies?: string[]; placeholder? }`.
   Layout: `InputGroup` with a `Select` (currency, with flag if easy) + masked number input ("0,00"). Use a currency
   mask added to `src/lib/masks.ts` via `bun cli mask` (or Maskito number options inline). Emits integer cents. Story it.
4. **i18n keys:** add a `dashboard` namespace block to `pt.json` + `en.json` covering all the labels below.

## SDK hooks + KEYED output shapes (all exist + regenerated)
All hooks from `@bk-dash/client-typescript/typescript`. Read hooks take query params object; mutations: `const m = useX(); await m.mutateAsync({ data }, { onSuccess, onSettled })`. Metric = `{ value: number, deltaPct: number|null }`. Tally = `{ count: Metric, value: Metric }`.

- **useGetPixelFunnel** → `{ hasPixel, base: Metric, steps: { PAGE_VIEWED: Metric, PRODUCT_VIEWED, PRODUCT_ADDED_TO_CART, PRODUCT_REMOVED_FROM_CART, CART_VIEWED, CHECKOUT_STARTED, CHECKOUT_CONTACT_INFO_SUBMITTED, CHECKOUT_COMPLETED }, conversionRate: Metric, carts: Tally }`. Query params: `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate, productIds? }` (default last 30 days).
- **useGetDashboard** → discriminated by `kind` (`SINGLE_GLOBAL`|`SINGLE_NATIONAL`|`MULTI_GLOBAL`|`MULTI_NATIONAL`). Use SINGLE (kind starts `SINGLE_`): `{ kind, tenancyScope, dashboardMode, store, stat, details }`. `details = { orders, fees, ads, productCost, chargeback: { byStatus:{total:Metric,segments}, fees:Metric }, refund: Metric, taxes: { ads:Metric, others:Metric }, operational: { total: Metric, items: [...] } }`. Query params `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate, productIds? }`.
- **useListQuickProductRanking** → `{ totalProducts: number, items: { productId, name, imageUrl: string|null, sales: Tally }[] }` (top 10). `sales.value` = revenue (money), `sales.count` = units sold.
- **useGetGoal** → `{ goal: { id, storeId, type:'REVENUE'|'PROFIT', targetAmount:{ amountCents, currency }, from, to } | null }`. Query `{}` (session store).
- **useGetGoalProgress** → `{ byType: { REVENUE?: { target:number, achieved:number, stores:[{storeId,storeName,target,achieved}] }, PROFIT?: {...} } }`. Query `{ tenancyScope:'SINGLE_STORE', startDate, endDate }`.
- Mutations: **useCreateGoal**(`createGoalMutationRequestSchema`: `{ type, currency, targetAmount:{amountCents,currency}, from, to }` — check exact), **useUpdateGoal**(`{ goalId, data }`), **useCreateOperationalCost**(`createOperationalCostMutationRequestSchema`: `{ flow:'CREDIT'|'DEBIT', amount/currency, name, frequency, startDate, endDate?, category? }` — check exact), **useUpsertWarranty**(`upsertWarrantyMutationRequestSchema`: `{ percentage, startDate, periodDays }` — check exact). Invalidate the relevant query key on success; toast via `sonner`.

> Use the generated `*MutationRequestSchema` directly as TanStack Form `validators.onChange`. Inspect the exact request
> field names in the generated `…Schema.ts`/types before wiring (names above are best-effort).

## Form pattern (TanStack Form + SDK schema)
`useForm({ defaultValues, validators:{ onChange: <op>MutationRequestSchema }, onSubmit: async f => { const r = schema.safeParse(f.value); if(!r.success) return; await mutation.mutateAsync({ data: r.data }, { onSuccess, onSettled }) } })`. Submit gated via `form.Subscribe`. Drawers use `<Sheet>`; close on success.

## Storybook
CSF3 (`Meta`/`StoryObj`), `@storybook/react-vite`. NO QueryClient/MSW in preview → **only story leaf/prop-driven
components** (pass mock data as args) + skeleton/empty states. Do NOT story hook-owning Sections. Place stories at
`<Name>/stories/<Name>.stories.tsx` (or `<Name>/<Name>.stories.tsx`). Mirror `src/components/StatCard/StatCard.stories.tsx`.

---

# COMPONENTS (each agent: build ONE cluster under `-components/`, with leaf stories; DO NOT edit the route `index.tsx`)

## A) FunnelSection  (hook: useGetPixelFunnel)
Card spanning a row. 5 step columns + a right rail with 2 highlight cards.
- **FunnelStep** (leaf ×5): label (Page View / View Content / Add to Cart / Initiate Checkout / Purchase →
  PAGE_VIEWED, PRODUCT_VIEWED, PRODUCT_ADDED_TO_CART, CHECKOUT_STARTED, CHECKOUT_COMPLETED), big `%` (step.value/base.value),
  small "{count} de {base}" with a users icon, and a purple area/bar whose height ∝ the fraction (simple SVG/CSS, sloping
  down to the next step is decorative — a filled trapezoid is fine). Props: `{ label, pct, count, base }`. Story it.
- **FunnelHighlightCard** (leaf ×2): "Taxa de Conversão" (value=conversionRate %, delta) and "Carrinhos"
  (value=carts.value money, delta) — each: icon + label + info hint + big value + metric-delta. Props-driven. Story it.
- Empty state: `hasPixel === false` → show a "instalar Pixel" CTA instead of steps.

## B) AdditionalCostsSection  (hook: useGetDashboard, store: useDashboardStore)  + 2 drawers
Card. Header: money icon badge + "Custos Adicionais" + big total (sum of the rows below, derived). A **Checkbox**
"Descontar Custos Adicionais" bound to `useDashboardStore` (`discountAdditionalCosts` / `toggleDiscountAdditionalCosts`).
Separator. Rows (label + value in RED money): Chargeback (`details.chargeback.byStatus.total.value`), Reembolso
(`details.refund.value`), Impostos (`details.taxes.ads.value + details.taxes.others.value`), Operacional
(`details.operational.total.value`), Garantia (warranty — NO read hook yet → show "Sem Garantia" in green).
- Impostos / Operacional / Garantia rows each have a small purple **+** button.
  - Operacional **+** → opens **OperationalCostDrawer** (Sheet) — form via **useCreateOperationalCost** +
    `createOperationalCostMutationRequestSchema`. Fields: Saída/Entrada (flow checkboxes, exactly one), Valor
    (**MoneyInput**), Descrição (input), Frequência (Select), Data de Início (DatePicker), Categoria (Select). Title
    "Adicionar Custo Operacional".
  - Garantia **+** → opens **WarrantyDrawer** (Sheet) — form via **useUpsertWarranty** + its schema. Fields:
    Porcentagem de Garantia (% input), Data de Início (DatePicker), Período (Select e.g. "30 dias"). Submit "Editar Garantia".
  - Impostos **+** → link to `/app/settings/taxesAndFees` (no drawer provided) — use a Link/navigate; flag as follow-up.
- Story the leaf row (`AdditionalCostRow` with props label/value/tone/onAdd?) + the drawers' form bodies if practical.

## C) GoalSection  (hooks: useGetGoal + useGetGoalProgress)  + Goal drawer
Card. Header "Meta de Faturamento" + an edit **pencil** button (top-right) → opens **GoalDrawer**. Body: **Gauge**
(value = achieved/target capped 0..1) with big `%` centered; below: "{achievedMoney} de {targetMoney}" (achieved green,
target muted). Pick the active goal from `useGetGoal().goal`; type=goal.type → read `useGetGoalProgress().byType[goal.type]`
for `{ target, achieved }`. Empty: goal === null → "Nenhuma meta cadastrada" + a "criar meta" affordance opening the drawer.
- **GoalDrawer** (Sheet): form via **useCreateGoal** (or **useUpdateGoal** when editing an existing goal). Title
  "Meta de Faturamento". Fields: Meta (**MoneyInput**), Data de Início da Meta (DatePicker), Data de Fim da Meta
  (DatePicker), "Selecione o tipo da sua meta" → Faturamento/Lucro (REVENUE/PROFIT, two checkboxes/radio, exactly one).
  Submit "Editar Meta"/"Criar Meta". Prefill from the current goal when editing.
- Story the gauge-display leaf with mock `{ pct, achieved, target, currency }`.

## D) RankingSection  (hook: useListQuickProductRanking)
Card. Header: package icon badge + "Ranking" + big `{totalProducts}` + a "Ver Tudo" button → Link `/app/products`.
Separator. Scrollable list (max ~3.5 rows visible) of **RankingProductRow** (leaf ×N, top 10): square product image
(`imageUrl` or placeholder), name (truncate), `{salesValueMoney}` (sales.value.value), and "{salesCount} Vendido(s)"
(sales.count.value) right-aligned. Props-driven leaf. Story it (with image + placeholder variants).
